website_content.markdown_content:
## PSPCL JE Electrical Result 2026 Overview

The **Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL)** has officially released the **Provisional Result and Combined Merit List (CML)** for candidates who appeared for the post of **Junior Engineer/Electrical (CRA No. 316/26)**.

### Key Recruitment Details
* **Recruiting Body:** Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL)
* **Post Name:** Junior Engineer / Electrical
* **Total Vacancies:** 622
* **Exam Date:** 31st July 2026 (Shift 1 & 2)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Total Candidates Qualified:** 3,541

### Important Dates
* **CBT Exam Date:** 31st July 2026
* **Answer Key Release:** 4th August 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** 12th September 2026

### Candidate Instructions
* **Verification:** Carefully cross-check your roll number and name against your admit card.
* **Provisional Status:** This is a provisional result; candidates must stay updated via the official website for the next stage of recruitment (e.g., document verification).
* **Discrepancies:** If any errors are found in name, category, or marks, report them immediately through the official PSPCL channels.
* **Documentation:** Maintain a printed copy of the result PDF and your admit card for future reference.

website_content.title: UPSSSC Master Answer Key 2026: Assistant Boring Technician & Teacher Cadre
website_content.summary: UPSSSC has released the final descriptive master answer keys for the Assistant Boring Technician and Teacher Cadre (PWD Directorate) Main Exams. Candidates who appeared for the exams on 12 July 2026 can now verify their final scores.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC)** has officially released the final master answer keys for two specific main examinations conducted in July 2026. These keys have been finalized after a thorough review of the objections raised against the provisional keys.

## Exams Covered
* **Assistant Boring Technician** (Advertisement No. 04-Exam/2026) - Minor Irrigation Department
* **Teacher Cadre - PWD Directorate** (Advertisement No. 03-Exam/2026) - Directorate of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, UP

## Key Timeline
* **Exam Date:** 12 July 2026
* **Provisional Keys Released:** 13 & 14 July 2026
* **Objection Deadline:** 15 July 2026
* **Master Answer Key Release:** 12 September 2026

## Important Details
* **Total Questions:** 100 questions per exam.
* **Set Codes:** QZ2 (Assistant Boring Technician) and XR9 (Teacher Cadre).
* **Nature of Key:** Master/Final Descriptive set.

## Steps to Download
1. Visit the official portal at **upsssc.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **'Answer Key'** or **'Notices'** section.
3. Locate the notice corresponding to your advertisement number (03-Exam/2026 or 04-Exam/2026).
4. Download the PDF and match your question paper set code with the final key.

website_content.title: Deoghar Home Guard (Grih Rakshak) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: JGRV Deoghar has announced 772 vacancies for Rural and Urban Home Guard posts. Eligible candidates from Deoghar district must apply online by October 26, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Overview
Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), Deoghar has released Advertisement No. 01/2026 for the enrolment of **Home Guards (Grih Rakshak)**. This is a voluntary enrolment opportunity for residents of Deoghar to serve the nation.

## 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **772**
* **Rural Home Guard:** 635 Posts (Block-wise distribution)
* **Urban Home Guard:** 137 Posts (Technical & Non-Technical)
* **Women's Reservation:** 50% of posts are earmarked for women.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
### 1. Educational Qualification
* **Rural Home Guard:** Minimum 7th class pass.
* **Urban Home Guard:** Minimum Matric (10th) pass.

### 2. Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 19 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 40 Years

### 3. Residence
* Candidates must be permanent/ordinary residents of the respective Deoghar block or urban area.

### 4. Physical Standards
| Parameter | Male (Gen/OBC/BC) | Male (ST/SC) | Female (All) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Height** | 162 cm | 157 cm | 148 cm |
| **Chest** | 79 cm | 76 cm | N/A |

## 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Race, High Jump, Long Jump, and Shot Put.
2. **Hindi Writing Ability Test:** Qualifying test (30% minimum marks).
3. **Technical Skill Test:** Only for Urban Technical candidates.
4. **Final Phase:** Merit List $\rightarrow$ Document Verification $\rightarrow$ Medical $\rightarrow$ Police Verification.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 11 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 26 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Exam Dates:** To be announced via newspapers/website.

## 💰 Application Fee & Allowance
* **Fee:** Rs. 100/- (Online payment)
* **Allowance:** This is a **voluntary enrolment**, not a salaried job. Duty allowance is paid only for days actually deployed on duty.

website_content.title: NFR Sports Quota Result 2026 - Basketball & Cricket Eligibility List
website_content.summary: Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) has announced the provisional eligibility lists for Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27. Candidates marked as 'Not Eligible' must submit their representations by September 13, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27

The Office of the Senior Personnel Officer/Recruitment, N.F. Railway, Maligaon, has released the **provisional lists of eligible and not eligible candidates** for the sports quota recruitment under Notification No. 04/2026.

### 📋 Recruitment Overview
* **Disciplines:** Basketball and Cricket
* **Notification No:** 04/2026
* **Reference No:** E/227/Rectt./Sports/2026-27
* **Status:** Provisional (Subject to alteration)

### 📊 Candidate Statistics
* **Eligible Candidates:** 113 Total (Basketball: 52 | Cricket: 61)
* **Not Eligible Candidates:** 115 Total (Basketball: 36 | Cricket: 79)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **List Release Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Representation Deadline:** 13 September 2026, 5:30 PM (17:30 hrs)

### 🔍 How to Verify Your Status
1. Access the official Eligible/Not Eligible PDF.
2. Search using your **Application Number** (NFRBS... for Basketball, NFRCR... for Cricket).
3. Note your Sl. No. and any specific remarks mentioned against your name.

### ⚠️ Action for Ineligible Candidates
If you have been wrongly marked as 'Not Eligible', you can submit a representation via email. 
* **Requirement:** Attach a copy of the application form and all supporting documents.
* **Strict Deadline:** Representations after **13 Sept 2026, 5:30 PM** will not be considered.

### 📢 Important Instructions
* **Selection Trials:** Call letters are being sent to eligible candidates via **email only**.
* **Disclaimer:** Inclusion in the eligible list does not guarantee appointment in Railway services.

website_content.title: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Urban Local Bodies (ULB) Group-C Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: KEA invites online applications for 210 Group-C vacancies including Electricians and Water Supply Operators in the Kalyana-Karnataka region. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), on behalf of the Directorate of Municipal Administration, is recruiting for **Group-C posts** within the Urban Local Bodies (ULB) of the Kalyana-Karnataka region.

## Vacancy Details
Total posts available: **210**
* Water Supply Operator
* Electrician Grade-1
* Assistant Water Supply Operator
* Electrician Grade-2

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 30 September 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 1 October 2026

## Selection Process
Selection is based solely on a competitive written examination (No Interview):
* **Paper-1:** General Knowledge
* **Paper-2:** Post-specific technical/trade subject
* **Negative Marking:** 0.25 marks deducted for every wrong answer.
* **Language Requirement:** A qualifying Kannada Language Test may be applicable.

## Application Guidelines
* **Mode:** Online only.
* **Restriction:** Candidates can apply for **only one post**.
* **Caution:** No corrections are allowed after final submission. Verify all details carefully.
* **Merit-Based:** Recruitment is based purely on written exam merit; avoid fake agents.

website_content.markdown_content:
## GMC Ongole Revised Merit List 2026

The Prakasam District Administration, Government of Andhra Pradesh, has officially published the **Revised Merit List** for various outsourced and contract positions at the Government Medical College (GMC), Ongole. 

**Key Recruitment Details:**
* **Organization:** Government Medical College (GMC), Ongole
* **Administering Authority:** Prakasam District Administration
* **Selection Stage:** Final/Revised Merit List
* **Total Posts Covered:** 20 Different Positions
* **Publication Mode:** Online PDF

**List of Posts Included:**
The merit lists cover a wide range of administrative and technical roles, including:
* **Administrative:** Junior Assistant, Typist DEO, FNO, MNO.
* **Technical/Medical:** Radiographer, Optometrist, Dialysis Technician, ECG Technician, Speech Therapist.
* **Support Staff:** Lab Attendant, Stretcher Boy, Theatre Assistant, Plumber, Electrician Mechanic, Attender, Mortuary Attender, and House Keeper Warden.

**Important Dates:**
* **PDF Upload Period:** September 2026
* **Start Date for Viewing:** 12 September 2026
* **End Date for Viewing:** 19 September 2026

**How to Check Your Name:**
1. Visit the official Prakasam District recruitment notice board.
2. Find the notification titled "Revised merit list for various posts in GMC Ongole."
3. Select the PDF corresponding to the post you applied for.
4. Use the search function (Ctrl+F) to locate your name or application number.

website_content.summary: Surat Municipal Corporation has released the provisional answer keys and OMR download instructions for Supervisor, Junior Pharmacist, Assistant Auditor, and Technical Officer posts. Candidates must submit objections by September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SMC Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Recruitment Department has released the official notice regarding the provisional answer keys for the written examinations held on **06/09/2026**. This update is critical for candidates who appeared for the following positions:

* **Supervisor (Computer)**
* **Junior Pharmacist**
* **Assistant Auditor**
* **Technical Officer**

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notice Release Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Answer Key Objection Window:** 11 September to 15 September 2026
* **Last Date to Download OMR Sheet:** 17 September 2026

### 📥 How to Download Your OMR Sheet
Candidates must download their OMR sheets before the deadline to avoid missing out:
1. Visit the **RECRUITMENT** section on the official SMC website.
2. Click on the **"ANSWER KEY(S)"** link.
3. Enter your **Application Number** (Format: AAAA/BBBBBB/CCC/DDDDDD), **Seat Number**, and **Date of Birth**.
4. Save the PDF for your records.

### ⚠️ Objection Process (Query Reporting)
If you disagree with the provisional answer key, you may raise an objection under these conditions:
* **Format:** Use the prescribed "Query Reporting Form for Provisional Answer Key".
* **Evidence:** Attach a certified/self-attested color scanned copy of valid documentary evidence.
* **Submission:** Send via e-mail to the official recruitment email address.
* **Deadline:** Objections must be submitted between **11/09/2026 and 15/09/2026**. Objections after this window will not be considered.

website_content.markdown_content:
## NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026

The District Health Society, under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, has announced a massive recruitment drive for **Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurses**. These positions are available across institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Medical and Rural Health Services, Medical Education & Research, and the Greater Chennai Corporation.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 4,724
* **Post Name:** Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse
* **Nature of Job:** Purely Temporary / Contract Basis
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Physical Submission)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess a **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)** or **B.Sc. Nursing** degree from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institution.
* **Professional Registration:** Valid registration with the **Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council** is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum age is **50 years**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25-09-2026 (until 5:00 PM)

### 📍 Job Locations
Vacancies are available across districts of Tamil Nadu. 
**Note:** This recruitment is NOT applicable to **Tiruppur** and **Chengalpattu** districts due to the Model Code of Conduct.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the application form and district-wise vacancy details from the official NHM-TN website.
2. Complete the form and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.
3. Submit the physical application to the **Office of the District Health Officer/District Health Society** of the concerned district by the deadline.

website_content.markdown_content:
## 👮 Ladakh Police Constable Recruitment 2026

The Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh, via the **Ladakh Police Subordinate Service Recruitment Board (LPSSRB)**, has announced direct recruitment for the post of **Constable (Level-02)**. 

### 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **331**
* **Executive, Armed/IRP, SDRF:** 141 Posts
* **Border Battalion:** 168 Posts (District-wise)
* **Women Battalion:** 22 Posts (District-wise)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Passed 10th Class/Matriculation from a recognized board. 
  * *Special Case:* Serving SPOs with 3+ years of service are eligible with an 8th Pass qualification.
* **Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026):** 18 to 28 years.
  * **Relaxations:** SC/ST/ALC (5 years); Serving SPOs/VHGs (Up to 37 years).
* **Domicile:** Must possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the UT of Ladakh.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Physical Standard Test (PST):** Qualifying
2. **Physical Endurance Test (PET):** Qualifying
3. **Document Scrutiny:** Qualifying
4. **Incentive Marks:** Up to 5% for NCC/Computer/Driving License
5. **Written Examination:** 100 Marks (Objective Type)

### 📖 Written Exam Pattern
* **General Knowledge:** 60 Marks
* **Reasoning:** 15 Marks
* **Arithmetic Abilities:** 15 Marks
* **General Science:** 10 Marks
* **Duration:** 80 Minutes | **Negative Marking:** None

### 💰 Application Fee
* **UR/EWS:** ₹600
* **SC/ST/ALC:** ₹500

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 24 August 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 29 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 15 September 2026
* **PST/PET Commencement:** 22 September 2026 onwards

website_content.title: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Departmental Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: MPESB invites applications for 73 Naib Tehsildar posts through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination. This recruitment is exclusively for eligible serving employees of the MP Revenue Department.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Recruitment Overview
**MPESB** has announced the **Naib Tehsildar Departmental Limited Competitive Examination 2026**. Please note that this is a **Limited Departmental Exam** and is NOT open to the general public.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 01 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 17 September to 06 October 2026
* **Probable Exam Date:** Starting from 14 November 2026

### 🔢 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **73**
* **Clerical Service Cadre:** 46 Posts
* **Patwari/Revenue Inspector Cadre:** 27 Posts
*(Includes Direct Recruitment and Backlog vacancies)*

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Departmental Status:** Must be a regular/officiating employee for at least **5 years** in the Revenue Mandal, Commissioner Land Records, Principal Revenue Commissioner, Divisional Commissioner, or Collector establishments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, or Agriculture from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **55 years** as of 01 January 2026.

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale:** Level-9 (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800)
* **Application Fee:** ₹2,000 (plus portal charges)

### ✍️ Selection Process
Selection is based on two objective-type papers (100 marks each):
* **Paper I:** General Reasoning, GK, Hindi, English, Maths, Science, and Computer Knowledge.
* **Paper II:** Govt Service Rules, Revenue Terminology, Land Revenue Code 1959, Revenue Book Circular, and Land Records Rules.
* **Qualifying Marks:** 55% for General; 40% for SC/ST.

website_content.summary: The State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP) has released the 2nd round seat allotment results for ITI admissions 2026. Candidates must complete their physical reporting and fee payment by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP ITI Admission 2026 - 2nd Round Seat Allotment

The **State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP)** has announced the 2nd Allotment Result for admissions into Government and Private Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the state for the 2026 session.

### 📌 Key Admission Details
* **Admission Mode:** Purely Merit-Based (No written exam).
* **Eligibility Basis:** Marks obtained in Class 8th or Class 10th.
* **Allocation Process:** Seat allotment is conducted in multiple rounds. Candidates not allotted a seat in the first round are automatically considered for subsequent rounds.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **2nd Allotment Result Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Reporting & Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Allotment Result
1. Visit the official admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Round 2 seat allotment result'** section.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password**.
4. View your allotted institute and trade/branch.
5. Download and print the **Seat Allotment Letter** for the physical reporting process.

### ⚠️ Crucial Instructions
* **Login Credentials:** Note that Round 2 requires an Application Number and Password (unlike Round 1 which used DOB).
* **Freeze vs Float:** If the option is available, 'Floating' allows you to seek a better seat in the next round, while 'Freezing' confirms your current seat.
* **Deadline:** Failure to report to the allotted institute by **17 September 2026** will result in the forfeiture of the seat.

website_content.markdown_content:
## OSSSC Nursing Officer (Group C) Recruitment 2026

The **Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the Nursing Officer (Group C) recruitment process. Candidates who applied for the **5,989 vacancies** can now access their admission letters online.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Written Exam (CBRE) Dates:** 22 and 23 September 2026
* **Exam Schedule Notice:** Released on 21 August 2026

### 📝 Exam Overview
* **Post Name:** Nursing Officer (Group C)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE)
* **Selection Process:** Written Examination followed by Document Verification

### 📥 How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official website **osssc.gov.in**.
2. Click the **Login** button on the top-right corner.
3. Enter your **User ID/Username**, **Password**, and the captcha code.
4. Access the candidate dashboard and select **Download Admission Letter**.
5. Save the PDF and print at least **two clear A4 copies**.

### ⚠️ Essential Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Document:** A physical printed copy of the admit card is required for entry.
* **Punctuality:** Reach the exam centre well before the mentioned reporting time.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, and study materials are strictly forbidden inside the hall.
* **Verification:** Carefully check your name, photograph, exam shift, and centre address upon downloading.

website_content.markdown_content:
## WBUAFS B.F.Sc. (Hons.) Admission 2026-2027

The West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences (WBUAFS) has released the official notification for the **Counselling cum Admission** process for the 4-year Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)] degree program.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Counselling & Physical Reporting:** 15-09-2026
* **Reporting Time:** 10:45 A.M. to 11:45 A.M.
* **Commencement of Classes:** 16-09-2026

### 🎓 Course Overview
* **Course:** Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)]
* **Duration:** 4 Years
* **Academic Session:** 2026-2027

### 📜 Reservation & Eligibility Rules
* **OBC Candidates:** Must provide a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. Without this, candidates will be treated as General/UR.
* **EWS Certificates:** Must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 as per West Bengal Government guidelines.
* **Domicile Proof:** Domicile certificates issued by elected representatives (MLA, MP, Councilor, etc.) are **NOT acceptable**. Use Proforma b or e-District certificates.
* **PwD:** Seats are filled on a horizontal basis within respective categories.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Merit-Based:** Admissions are strictly based on the Provisional Merit List.
* **Documents:** Original documents are mandatory for verification during reporting.
* **Anti-Ragging:** Selected candidates must submit an online Anti-Ragging affidavit via www.antiragging.in or www.amanmovement.org at the time of registration.
* **Provisional Nature:** All admissions are provisional and subject to verification of documents and eligibility.

website_content.title: ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026: Apply for Technical Assistant, Technician 'B' & More
website_content.summary: ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) invites online applications for 22 specialized posts across various technical and support roles. The application window is open from 15 September to 5 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚀 ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026

The **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)**, located in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu, has released a recruitment notification (Advt No. IPRC/RMT/2026/01) for various technical and support positions. 

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 05 October 2026

### 🛠️ Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Qualification |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Technical Assistant** (Auto/Mech/EC) | 5 | First Class Diploma in relevant branch |
| **Technician 'B'** (Turner/Fitter/Welder/etc) | 13 | 10th Std + ITI (NCVT/NAC) |
| **Cook 'A'** | 1 | 10th Std + 5 Years Experience |
| **Fireman 'A'** | 3 | 10th Std + Physical Fitness |

### 💰 Pay Scale
* **Technical Assistant:** Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 – Rs. 1,42,400)
* **Technician ‘B’:** Level 3 (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100)
* **Cook ‘A’ & Fireman ‘A’:** Level 2 (Rs. 19,900 – Rs. 63,200)

### 🎓 Eligibility Highlights
* **Technical Assistant:** Must possess a **First Class Diploma** in the specified engineering discipline.
* **Technician 'B':** Must have passed **10th/SSC** and hold an **ITI certificate** with NTC/NAC from NCVT.
* **Cook 'A':** Requires a certificate of experience from a well-established hotel/canteen (individual certificates not accepted).
* **Fireman 'A':** Requires 10th pass and a **Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate** to be uploaded during application.

### 📝 Selection Process
* **Cook 'A':** Selection involves a **Skill Test** based on experience certificates.
* **Fireman 'A':** Candidates must meet prescribed **Physical Fitness Standards**.
* For other posts, please refer to the detailed advertisement on the official portal.

The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) has officially hosted the OMR answer sheet copies for candidates who appeared in three specific examinations as per Press Release No. 110/2026.

website_content.title: HAL Design Trainee & Management Trainee Interview Call Letter 2026
website_content.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released the interview call letters for the Design Trainee (DT) and Management Trainee (MT) 2026 recruitment. Shortlisted candidates can now download their letters for the personal interviews scheduled in Bengaluru.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HAL DT & MT Interview Call Letter 2026

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna CPSE, has officially issued the **Interview Call Letters** for candidates who cleared the CBT written exam for the posts of **Design Trainee (DT)** and **Management Trainee (MT)**.

### 📌 Quick Overview
* **Organization:** Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
* **Advertisement No:** HAL/CHRC-TM/RECT-02/2026
* **Total Vacancies:** 120 (60 DT + 60 MT)
* **Current Stage:** Interview Call Letter Download
* **Interview Venue:** Bengaluru

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Interview Call Letter Release:** 12 September 2026
* **Personal Interview Dates:** 21 to 25 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official login portal at **cbexams.com**.
2. Navigate to the link for **Interview Call Letter - DT/MT 2026**.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Download the call letter and take at least two clear printouts.

### 📂 Documents Required for Interview
* **Printed Call Letter:** Mandatory copy of the interview letter.
* **Identity Proof:** Valid government-issued photo ID.
* **Educational Records:** Original and photocopies of all mark sheets and degree certificates.
* **Category Certificate:** Valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates (if applicable).
* **PwBD Certificate:** From a competent authority (if claiming reservation).

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Single Application:** Candidates who applied for both DT and MT posts face rejection.
* **Posting Locations:** Selected trainees may be posted in Bengaluru, Tumakuru, Hyderabad, Nasik, Koraput, Barrackpore, Lucknow, Kanpur, or Korwa.
* **Caution:** HAL does not take payments for employment; beware of fraudsters.

website_content.markdown_content:

website_content.title: BLW Varanasi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) invites online applications from eligible Indian sportspersons for 25 vacancies across various sports disciplines. The application window closes on October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏆 BLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27

Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW), Varanasi, under Indian Railways, is recruiting talented sportspersons for **25 positions** under the Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) for the year 2026-27.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **25**
* **Basketball (Men):** 6 Posts
* **Volleyball (Men):** 7 Posts
* **Wrestling (Men):** 4 Posts
* **Handball (Men):** 8 Posts

**Pay Level Distribution:**
* Pay Level-5: 2 Posts
* Pay Level-2: 8 Posts
* Pay Level-1: 15 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualification:**
* **Pay Level 5:** Graduation/Degree from a recognized university.
* **Pay Level 2:** 12th Pass (+2 stage) or equivalent.
* **Pay Level 1:** 10th Pass / ITI or equivalent.

**Sports Qualification:**
Candidates must meet specific achievement norms (Category A, B, or C) based on the Pay Level they are applying for. Achievements must be from events held on or after **01.04.2024**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12.09.2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 12.10.2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01.01.2027

### 🔞 Age Limit (as of 01.01.2027)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 25 Years
* *Note: No age relaxation is provided for any community.*

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General Category:** ₹400
* **SC/ST/Ex-SM/PwBD/Minorities/EBC:** ₹250
* **Note:** Fees are **refundable** for candidates who actually appear in the trials.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a composite score of 100 marks:
1. **Sports Trials:** 40 Marks (Minimum 25 required to be 'FIT')
2. **Sports Achievements:** 50 Marks
3. **Educational Qualification:** 10 Marks

**Final Step:** Medical Examination and a mandatory 5-year Service Bond.

website_content.summary: NCRTC is recruiting for 90 technical posts including Supervisor-I and Junior Maintainer for the Namo Bharat Project. Apply by October 9, 2026, via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚆 NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Overview
NCRTC has announced vacancies under two separate notices for the **Namo Bharat Project**. This is a prime opportunity for technical graduates and diploma holders to work with a prestigious Joint Venture of the Govt of India and State Governments.

### 📊 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Notice No. 33/2026 (Contract Basis):** 23 Posts (Supervisor-I & Junior Maintainer)
* **Notice No. 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment):** 67 Posts (Operations & Maintenance Staff)
* **Total Vacancies:** 90

### 🛠️ Post Details & Eligibility
**1. Supervisor-I (Pay Level S1):**
* **Trades:** IT, Full Stack Developer, Corporate Hospitality, Corporate Communications, Electrical, Civil, Electronics, Mechanical, and Operations.
* **Qualification:** B.E/B.Tech, 3-Year Diploma, or relevant Graduate/PG degree in the specified field.

**2. Junior Maintainer (Pay Level NS3):**
* **Trades:** Electrical, Fitter, RAC, and Electronics.
* **Qualification:** ITI (NCVT/SCVT) certificate in the relevant trade. (**Note:** Higher qualifications are not accepted for ITI posts).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Application Starts:** 10.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs)
* **Tentative CBT Date:** November/December 2026

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Supervisor-I:** Initial Basic Pay ₹37,000 (Scale: ₹37,000 – ₹1,15,000)
* **Junior Maintainer:** Initial Basic Pay ₹18,250 (Scale: ₹18,250 – ₹59,200)
* **Additional Perks:** VDA, HRA, and Cafeteria allowances as per company rules.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. No negative marking.
2. **Medical Fitness Test:** Standards as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM).

### 🕒 Age Limit (as of 10.09.2026)
* **Maximum Age:** 28 Years
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

website_content.markdown_content:
## JKSSB BCG Technician & Para Medical Assistant Answer Key 2026

The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has published the provisional answer key for the OMR-based written examination conducted for the posts of **BCG Technician** and **Para Medical Assistant** under Notification No. 07 of 2025.

### Key Highlights & Exam Shifts
* **Conducting Authority:** Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB)
* **Notification No.:** 07 of 2025
* **Exam Date:** 10th September 2026
* **Shift I (BCG Technician):** 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Item Nos. 30–34)
* **Shift II (Para Medical Assistant):** 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM (Item Nos. 122–130)
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 10th September 2026

### Important Dates & Objection Schedule
* **Exam Conducted:** 10.09.2026
* **Provisional Answer Key Out:** 10.09.2026
* **Objection Window Starts:** 11.09.2026
* **Daily Objection Timing:** 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM (for 3 working days)

### How to Raise Objections (Offline Mode Only)
* Download and fill the representation format (Annexure "C") from the official notification.
* Use a **separate form for each question** being challenged.
* Attach documentary proof/evidence supporting your claimed answer (hard copies only).

* Submit in person at **JKSSB Office Muthi, Akhnoor Road, Jammu** OR **JKSSB Office, Zamzam Building, Rambagh, Srinagar** between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM during the 3 working days starting 11.09.2026.

website_content.title: NEET MDS Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration and Schedule
website_content.summary: MCC has announced the Round 2 counselling cycle for NEET MDS 2026 AIQ seats starting September 10, 2026. Candidates seeking fresh registration or seat upgrades are eligible to participate.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is conducting the Round 2 counselling process for **50% All India Quota (AIQ)** seats in government dental colleges and **100% seats** in deemed/central universities. Simultaneously, various state authorities are releasing their respective state quota schedules.

## Eligibility for Round 2
Candidates may participate in Round 2 if they:
* Did not participate in Round 1.
* Did not secure a seat in Round 1.
* Wish to **upgrade** their previously allotted seat.

## Key Dates
* **Round 2 AIQ and State Schedule:** September 10, 2026

## How to Apply
1. **Registration:** New candidates must complete fresh registration; existing candidates can log in using previous credentials.
2. **Details:** Enter NEET MDS roll number, application number, and date of birth.
3. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and security deposit online.
4. **Choice Filling:** Select and lock preferred colleges/courses before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **Freeze vs Float:** Candidates who selected 'Freeze' are generally ineligible for further rounds. Those on 'Float' may seek upgrades.
* **Choice Locking:** Once locked, preferences cannot be edited.
* **Documentation:** Original documents must be ready for reporting to avoid forfeiture of the allotted seat.
* **Dual Tracking:** Candidates eligible for both AIQ and State quotas must track both portals independently.

website_content.title: Karnataka PGCET 2026 Claim Slip & Option Entry Guide
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the PGCET 2026 claim slips on September 10, 2026. This document is mandatory for candidates seeking admission to MBA, MCA, and MTech programs to proceed with option entry.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially released the claim slips for the **Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET) 2026**. This slip is a critical document required for the counselling and seat allotment process.

## Key Highlights
* **Exam:** Karnataka PGCET 2026
* **Eligible Courses:** MBA, MCA, and MTech
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Release Date:** September 10, 2026

## Steps to Download Claim Slip
1. Visit the official KEA PGCET portal.
2. Click on the **Karnataka PGCET 2026 claim slip** link on the login page.
3. Enter your **Application Number**, **Password**, and **Captcha**.
4. Verify your details and download the file as a **PDF**.

## Option Entry Process
Once the claim slip is downloaded, candidates can access the option entry dashboard:
* **Access:** Use the QR code on the claim slip or enter the application and PGCET number.
* **Verification:** Complete the OTP verification via the registered mobile number.
* **Payment:** Pay the mandatory option entry processing fee of **₹750**.
* **Preference:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.

## Important Instructions
* **PDF Format:** Always download the official PDF; avoid using screenshots for counselling.
* **Discrepancies:** Report any errors in category or eligibility to KEA immediately.
* **Preparation:** Keep your registered mobile number and application credentials ready for OTP verification.

website_content.title: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: UPSSSC has announced 132 vacancies for the post of Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak) across 13 disciplines. Eligible candidates with a valid PET-2025 score can apply by October 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
UPSSSC is inviting applications for the **Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak)** cadre under the Directorate General, Deendayal Upadhyay State Rural Development Institute. These are permanent positions offering a competitive pay scale.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 132 Posts
* **Pay Scale:** Level-6 (₹35,400 - ₹112,400)
* **Selection Process:** Main Written Examination (No Interview)
* **Application Mode:** Online

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 10-09-2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 05-10-2026
* **Correction Window Closes:** 12-10-2026

## Eligibility Criteria

### Age Limit (as of 01-07-2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 21 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 40 Years
*(Age relaxation applicable as per UP Govt norms)*

### Mandatory Requirement
* Candidates must possess a valid **PET-2025 score card**. Shortlisting for the Main Exam will be based on normalized PET-2025 scores (15 times the number of vacancies).

### Educational Qualifications
Qualifications vary by discipline. Most roles require at least **50% marks** in the following:
* **Agricultural Engineering:** Bachelor's degree in Agricultural Engineering
* **Plant Protection / Horticulture / Agronomy / Soil Science / Ag Extension:** B.Sc. (Agriculture)
* **Animal Husbandry:** B.V.Sc. or M.V.Sc.
* **Women Welfare:** B.Sc. in Home Science / Home Economics / Nutrition / Diet
* **Cooperation / Panchayat:** M.A. (Economics) / M.Sc. (Ag Economics) / M.Com / M.A. (Sociology)
* **Agriculture (Specific):** Postgraduate degree in Agriculture (min 55% marks)
* **Public Health:** Graduate degree + Sanitary Inspector certificate
* **Production:** Degree/Diploma in Agricultural/Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering + 2 years experience

## Exam Pattern
Selection is based on a 100-mark objective test (120 minutes) with **25% negative marking**:
* **Rural Development Knowledge:** 50 Marks
* **Analytical Ability & DI:** 15 Marks
* **Computer & IT Concepts:** 15 Marks
* **UP State General Knowledge:** 20 Marks

## Application Fee
* **All Categories (Gen/OBC/SC/ST):** ₹25 (Online processing fee)

website_content.title: NBEMS FMGE October 2026 Registration
website_content.summary: NBEMS has opened online registrations for the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) October 2026 session. Eligible candidates must apply by September 25, 2026, for the exam scheduled on October 31.
website_content.markdown_content:
## FMGE October 2026 Overview
The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is conducting the **Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE)** for the October 2026 session. This is a mandatory screening test for foreign medical graduates to obtain registration to practice medicine in India.

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 11, 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Registration End Date:** September 25, 2026 (11:55 PM)
* **Exam Date:** October 31, 2026
* **Expected Result Date:** November 30, 2026
* **NMC Eligibility Application Window:** September 1, 2026, to September 30, 2026

## Key Examination Details
* **Exam Format:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Exam Centers:** Across India
* **Application Fee:** ₹6,195 (Payable via UPI, Credit/Debit Card)

## Application Process
1. **Registration:** Create an account on the official NBEMS portal.
2. **Form Filling:** Enter personal and academic details accurately.
3. **Documentation:** Upload all required certificates as specified.
4. **Payment:** Complete the fee payment of ₹6,195.
5. **Submission:** Review the application and submit it before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **One Application Only:** Candidates submitting multiple forms may only receive an admit card for the application with the highest ID.
* **NMC Eligibility:** The NMC Eligibility Certificate must be applied for separately; it is not integrated into the FMGE application.

website_content.title: NMC MBBS Seat Matrix 2026-27
website_content.summary: The National Medical Commission (NMC) has released the official seat matrix for Undergraduate (MBBS) courses for the 2026-27 academic year. This matrix will serve as the foundational data for NEET UG 2026 counselling across government and private medical colleges.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Assessment & Rating Board (MARB) of the **National Medical Commission (NMC)** has officially published the seat matrix for MBBS courses for the academic session 2026-27. This list includes all approved intakes for medical colleges in India, excluding Institutes of National Importance (INIs).

## Key Highlights
* **Release Date:** September 10, 2026
* **Basis of Matrix:** Approvals granted as of July 13, 2026
* **Scope:** Covers Government and Private medical colleges (Excludes AIIMS and JIPMER)
* **Purpose:** Primary reference for NEET UG 2026 counselling

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Verification:** Candidates must cross-verify seat availability in the official matrix before filling choices during AIQ or State Quota counselling.
* **INI Seats:** Seats for AIIMS and JIPMER are **not** included in this list and will be notified separately.
* **Revisions:** The matrix is subject to change based on Appeal Committee decisions; candidates should re-check the portal closer to their counselling round.
* **Validity:** Only seats listed in this official matrix are valid for admission; any offer outside this matrix is invalid.
* **Counselling Schedule:** This notice is for the seat matrix only. For registration and round dates, refer to the **Medical Counselling Committee (MCC)** or respective state authorities.

## How to Access the Seat Matrix
1. Visit the official NMC portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Latest News'** or **'Notice Board'** section.
3. Locate the PDF titled **'Seat Matrix for Undergraduate (MBBS) Courses for the Academic Year 2026-27'**.
4. Download the PDF and use `Ctrl+F` to search for your preferred state or college.

website_content.title: UPSC Recruitment 2026 (Advt No. 11/2026) - 212 Vacancies
website_content.summary: UPSC is recruiting for 212 vacancies across 7 professional posts including Assistant Public Prosecutors, Medical Specialists, and Law Officers. Application window closes on October 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released Advertisement No. 11/2026 for the selection of candidates for seven distinct posts across various Central Government Ministries, Departments, and the UT of Ladakh.

## Vacancy Breakup
* **Assistant Public Prosecutor (Govt. of NCT of Delhi):** 140 Posts
* **Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine):** 60 Posts
* **Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy):** 4 Posts
* **Public Law Officer / District Litigation Officer (UT of Ladakh):** 4 Posts
* **Assistant Editor (Indian Bureau of Mines):** 2 Posts
* **Specialist Grade II (Anaesthesiology & Paediatrics):** 2 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical Roles:** MBBS plus PG degree/diploma in respective specialties with required teaching or clinical experience (usually 3-5 years).
* **Law Roles:** Degree in Law with required experience at the bar (2-3 years). Ladakh posts require a valid Domicile Certificate.
* **Assistant Editor:** Bachelor's degree in Journalism/Mass Communication or related field with 3 years of editing experience.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12.09.2026
* **Closing Date (General Posts):** 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs)
* **Closing Date (Ladakh Posts):** 09.10.2026

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Recruitment by Selection (Interview-based).
* **Shortlisting:** In case of high application volume, UPSC may implement shortlisting criteria based on desirable qualifications or a Recruitment Test (RT).
* **Suitability:** Minimum marks required in interviews vary by category (UR: 50, OBC: 45, SC/ST/PwBD: 40).

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS (Male):** ₹25
* **Women/SC/ST/PwBD:** Exempted

website_content.markdown_content:
## DU NCWEB Special Drive Cut-Off 2026 Overview

The **Non-Collegiate Women's Education Board (NCWEB)**, Delhi University has announced the **Special Drive Cut-Off List** for admission to **B.A (Programme)** and **B.Com** courses for the **2026-27 academic session**. Admissions under this drive are offered against remaining vacant seats across teaching centres like Miranda House, Hansraj, and others.

### Key Highlights & Admission Details

* **Conducting Body:** NCWEB, Delhi University
* **Courses Offered:** B.A (Programme) & B.Com
* **Target Group:** Women candidates residing in NCT Delhi
* **Cut-off Range (B.Com):** 40 to 79.5 (Miranda House recorded the highest general-category cut-off)

* **NCWEB Special Drive Cut-Off List Release:** September 7, 2026
* **Online Admission Window:** August 18, 2026 (10:00 AM) to August 20, 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **College Approval Deadline:** August 21, 2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** August 22, 2026

### Eligibility Criteria

* Candidates must have passed 10+2 / Senior Secondary Examination from a recognized board.
* Only female candidates residing in the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi are eligible for NCWEB admissions.

### How to Apply for NCWEB Special Drive Admission 2026

1. Visit the official DU admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **NCWEB** section.
3. Click on the link for **Special Drive Cut-Off List 2026-27** for B.A (Prog) or B.Com.
4. Verify your category and percentage against your preferred teaching centre.
5. If eligible, log in to your dashboard and select the course/centre combination.
6. Submit documents online for verification before the college approval deadline (**August 21, 2026**).
7. Pay the admission fee online on or before **August 22, 2026** to secure your seat.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
 The **Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB)** is conducting the final round of admissions for Class 11 (Intermediate) via the **Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS)**. This spot admission window is specifically for filling the remaining vacant seats across various institutions in Bihar.

* **Application Deadline:** September 18, 2026
* **Total Duration:** 4 Days

## Eligibility & Application Process
* **Eligibility:** Students who have completed Class 10 and are seeking admission into Class 11.
* **Existing Applicants:** Use your OFSS reference number/barcode and registered mobile number to generate the spot application.
* **New Applicants:** Register and fill out the **Common Application Form (CAF)** on the portal.
* **Selection:** Check the institution-wise vacant seat list and select your preferred school/college and stream.
* **Final Step:** Pay the fee (if applicable) and submit the printed application with original documents to the institution's principal for verification.

## Important Instructions
* **Urgency:** Seats are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
* **Final Opportunity:** As this is the final window, missing this deadline may result in losing a seat for the current academic session.
* **Verification:** Keep all original documents ready for physical verification at the selected school/college.

website_content.title: OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 100 Graduate, Diploma & ITI Posts
website_content.summary: Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL) has released an official recruitment notification for 100 Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Trade Apprentice positions. Odisha domiciles can register and apply online from September 2, 2026, until October 1, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview

Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL), a state-owned power transmission utility in Odisha, invites online applications from eligible Odisha domicile candidates for a 1-year apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961. A total of **100 seats** are available across Degree Engineering, Degree Non-Engineering, Diploma Technician, and ITI Trade disciplines.

## Vacancy Details & Stipend

* **Degree Engineering Apprentice (34 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹12,300/month**
  * Electrical: 32 | IT: 1 | Telecom: 1
* **Degree Non-Engineering Apprentice (7 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹12,300/month**
  * Human Resources: 4 | Finance: 2 | Law: 1
* **Diploma Technician Apprentice (23 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹10,900/month**
  * Electrical: 20 | Telecom: 1 | Civil: 2
* **ITI Trade Apprentice (36 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹9,600/month**
  * ITI Electrician: 33 | ITI Electronic Mechanic: 3

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **Degree Engg:** BE/B.Tech in Electrical, Computer Science/IT, or Electronics & Telecom / Instrumentation.
* **Degree Non-Engg:** MBA (HR) / MSW / PG Degree in Personnel Management OR M.Com / B.Com with CMA Inter OR LLM / LLB.
* **Diploma:** Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering.
* **ITI:** ITI in Electrician or Electronics Mechanic Trade.
* **Passing Year:** Qualifying exam must be completed during Academic Year **2023–24, 2024–25, or 2025–26** (Passed by 1 July 2026).

### General Conditions
* **Domicile:** Only Indian nationals belonging to the State of Odisha are eligible.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum 18 years as on **1 August 2026**.
* **Exclusions:** Candidates with existing job experience of 1 year or more or who have previously completed apprenticeship training are NOT eligible.
* **NATS/NAPS Registration:** Must be registered on NATS 2.0 or NAPS portal with an Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

## Selection Process

Selection will be based on academic merit, written test, or interview depending on the specific discipline requirements. Shortlisted candidates will be notified for document verification.

## Important Dates

* **Advertisement Date:** 29 August 2026
* **Online Application Start Date:** 2 September 2026 (12:00 AM)
* **Online Application Closing Date:** 1 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

## How to Apply

1. Register on the government portal:
   * Degree & Diploma candidates: Register on **NATS 2.0** (`nats.education.gov.in`).
   * ITI Trade candidates: Register on **NAPS** (`apprenticeshipindia.gov.in`).
2. Get your enrollment/registration number.
3. Visit the OPTCL Official Website (`optcl.co.in`) -> HRD Section -> Training & Development -> **Advertisement for Engagement of Apprentices 2026**.
4. Complete and submit the online application form before October 1, 2026.

website_content.title: NIT Agartala Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NIT Agartala invites online applications for 51 Non-Teaching positions across various Pay Levels. The application process closes on October 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
NIT Agartala is conducting a direct recruitment drive for **51 Non-Teaching posts** under the 7th CPC Pay Levels. Selection is based on a **Computer Based Test (CBT)** with no interviews involved.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Pay Level | Total Posts |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Technical Assistant | PL-6 | 7 |
| Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical) | PL-6 | 5 |
| Library & Information Assistant | PL-6 | 5 |
| SAS Assistant | PL-6 | 2 |
| Pharmacist | PL-5 | 1 |
| Senior Technician | PL-4 | 9 |
| Technician | PL-3 | 14 |
| Lab Attendant | PL-1 | 8 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Technical Assistant/JE:** First Class B.E./B.Tech/MCA or Diploma in relevant field.
* **Library Assistant:** Bachelor's degree in Science/Arts/Commerce + B.Lib.I.Sc.
* **SAS Assistant:** Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education with sports/cultural record.
* **Pharmacist:** B.Pharma or 10+2 (Science) + 2 years Diploma with experience.
* **Technician/Senior Technician:** 10+2 Science (60%) or 10th + ITI or Diploma.
* **Lab Attendant:** 10+2 in Science.

## Selection Process
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT).
* **Structure:** Most posts feature a two-part exam (Part I: General Aptitude; Part II: Technical/Subject specific).
* **Lab Attendant:** Single-part exam covering English, GK, Numerical Ability, and Computers.
* **No Interview:** Final merit is based solely on CBT marks.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start:** 20 September 2026 (10:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 20 October 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **CBT Date:** To be announced separately on the official website.

website_content.title: SSC SI Delhi Police and CAPFs Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is recruiting for 1,871 Sub-Inspector posts across Delhi Police and CAPFs. Eligible graduates can apply online from September 10 to September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚨 SSC Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced vacancies for **Sub-Inspectors (SI)** in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs). This is a premier opportunity for graduates to join the prestigious security forces of India.

### 📊 Vacancy Breakup
* **SI (GD) in CAPFs:** 1,467 Posts
* **SI (Executive) Delhi Police (Male):** 205 Posts
* **SI (Executive) Delhi Police (Female):** 112 Posts
* **SI (Fire) in CISF (Male):** 234 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** **1,871**

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Educational Qualification:**
* **SI (Delhi Police & CAPFs):** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
* **SI (Fire) CISF:** B.Sc (Physics, Chemistry, Math) **OR** Matriculation + 3-year Diploma in relevant Engineering fields.
* **Note:** Male candidates for Delhi Police must possess a valid **LMV Driving License** by the time of PE&MT.

**2. Age Limit (as of 01.08.2026):**
* **SI (Delhi Police/CAPFs):** 20–25 Years
* **SI (Fire) CISF:** 18–30 Years
* *Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/ESM as per Govt norms.*

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10.09.2026
* **Application End Date:** 30.09.2026 (23:00 hrs)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 01.10.2026
* **Correction Window:** 08.10.2026 to 10.10.2026

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹100
* **Women/SC/ST/ESM:** Exempted

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. **Paper-I:** Objective MCQ (Reasoning, GK, Quant, English)
2. **PST/PET:** Physical Standard & Endurance Tests (Qualifying)
3. **Paper-II:** Objective MCQ (Higher difficulty level)
4. **DME:** Detailed Medical Examination

### 💵 Pay Scale
* **Pay Level:** Level-6
* **Salary Range:** ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400

website_content.title: IIT JAM 2027 Registration and Application Process
website_content.summary: IIT Kharagpur invites applications for the Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) 2027. Registration is open from September 12 to October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IIT JAM 2027 Overview
The **Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) 2027** is organized by **IIT Kharagpur** for admission to postgraduate programs. The exam will be conducted as a Computer-Based Test (CBT) in two sessions.

## Important Dates
* **Information Brochure Released:** August 31, 2026
* **Registration Opens:** September 12, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** October 12, 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Exam Date:** February 14, 2027 (Sunday)

## Application Process
1. **Registration:** Register on the JOAPS portal using a valid email ID and mobile number.
2. **Enrolment:** Use the provided Enrolment ID and OTP to log in.
3. **Details:** Enter personal details, academic qualifications, test paper choices, and preferred exam cities.
4. **Documentation:** Upload photograph, signature, and relevant certificates in the prescribed format.
5. **Payment:** Pay the application fee via debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI.
6. **Submission:** Review all details carefully and submit the application.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Session Management:** Candidates opting for two subjects must ensure they fall in different sessions (forenoon and afternoon).
* **Document Accuracy:** Strictly follow the prescribed size and format for uploads to avoid rejection.
* **Verification:** Regularly check the registered email and JOAPS dashboard for any deficiency flags.
* **Correction Window:** Double-check all entries before submission, as changes are only possible during the official correction window.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
**UP D.EI.Ed (Diploma in Elementary Education)** Phase 2 counselling is now open for eligible candidates. Please note that this process is based on the state rank list already published in August.

## Important Dates
* **Choice Filling (Round 1):** September 7 to 10, 2026
* **Seat Allotment (Round 1):** September 11, 2026 (Expected)
* **Document Verification:** September 12 to 24, 2026
* **Choice Filling (Round 2):** September 11 to 15, 2026
* **Seat Allotment (Round 2):** September 16, 2026
* **Online Reporting/Locking:** September 25, 2026
* **Classes Commence:** September 28, 2026

## Eligibility for Phase 2
This round is specifically for candidates who have **not** yet received a training institute allotment, including:
* Candidates from other states
* UP resident OBC/SC/ST candidates
* Special reservation category candidates

## How to Check Your Rank/Allotment
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Know Your Rank'** section.
3. Select the appropriate rank-slab PDF (1-20k, 20k-80k, or 80k+) or log in using your registration number and date of birth.
4. Search for your name/application number to verify your status.

## Key Instructions
* Keep your **registration number, password, and DOB** ready for choice filling.
* Ensure document verification is completed by September 24 to secure the seat.

website_content.summary: Pt. B.D. Sharma University of Health Sciences (UHSR) has released the admit cards for the Common Entrance Test (CET) 2026. The exam for 12 UG and PG medical, paramedical, and nursing courses is scheduled for 13 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UHSR CET 2026 Overview
The **Pt. B.D. Sharma University of Health Sciences (UHSR)** has officially released the hall tickets for the Common Entrance Test (CET) 2026. This exam is the gateway for admission into **12 undergraduate and postgraduate paramedical and nursing programs** for the academic session 2026-27.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** 10 September 2026
* **Exam Date:** 13 September 2026 (Sunday)
* **Registration Deadline:** 02 September 2026

### 📝 Exam Pattern & Details
* **Total Marks:** 180 marks per paper.
* **Course Coverage:** 12 UG & PG Medical/Paramedical programs.
* **Requirement:** Candidates must use their registration number and date of birth to access the portal.

### 📲 Steps to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **CET 2026 section** on the homepage.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Submit the details and download the PDF.
5. Print **two color copies** on A4 paper for the exam day.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Photo ID:** Only original government photo IDs are accepted; photocopies are strictly prohibited.
* **Print Quality:** The admit card **MUST** be printed in color to ensure the photograph is verifiable.
* **Punctuality:** Late entry is not permitted; arrive well before the gate-closing time.
* **Corrections:** No changes to application forms are permitted after the 02 September deadline.

website_content.title: KEA PG NEET 2026 Dental (MDS) 1st Round Provisional Seat Allotment List
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has announced the 1st Round Provisional Seat Allotment List for PG NEET 2026 Dental (MDS). Candidates must verify their allotments and submit any objections by 8:00 PM on September 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially released the provisional seat allotment list for **PG NEET 2026 Dental (MDS)**. This list includes allotments for MDS and PG Diploma seats across government, private, and deemed dental colleges within Karnataka.

## Key Details
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Course:** PG NEET Dental (MDS) / PG Diploma
* **Document:** 1st Round Provisional Seat Allotment List
* **Publication Date:** 10 September 2026

## Important Dates
* **Allotment List Published:** 10 September 2026
* **Objection Deadline:** 10 September 2026, before **8:00 PM**

## How to Check Your Allotment
1. Access the official provisional allotment PDF.
2. Use the **Search/Find (Ctrl+F)** function to locate your **All India Rank (AIR)**.
3. Verify the following details: Allotted College, Course, Category, and Applicable Fee.
4. Cross-check the **Course Code** for absolute accuracy.

## Critical Instructions
* **Provisional Status:** This list is provisional; entries are subject to change before the final allotment.
* **Objection Process:** Objections must be submitted **strictly via email** to the official KEA email address.
* **Deadline Warning:** No extensions will be provided; objections must be received before 8:00 PM on 10 September 2026.
* **Language Options:** The list is available in both **English and Kannada**.

website_content.summary: GSSSB has released the provisional answer key for the CBRT exam held on September 8, 2026, covering 8 technical cadre posts. Candidates can now review their responses and submit online objections until September 16, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GSSSB CBRT Answer Key 2026 Overview

The Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) has published the **Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet** for the Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) conducted on **September 8, 2026**. This notification applies to eight technical cadre posts, including regular recruitment and special recruitment for Divyang candidates.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Date:** 8 September 2026
* **Notice Published:** 9 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 10 September 2026, 3:00 PM
* **Objection Window Closes:** 16 September 2026, 11:55 PM

### 📝 Exam Structure
* **Total Questions:** 210
* **Part-A:** 90 Questions
* **Part-B:** 120 Questions

### 🛠 How to Download the Answer Key
1. Log in to the candidate portal using your **Advertisement Number, Confirmation Number, and Date of Birth**.
2. Navigate to the **'Candidate Response'** tab.
3. Click the generate link to view your Participant ID, responses, and the official key.
4. Save the document as a PDF for future reference.

### 🚩 Process to Raise Objections
If you disagree with the provisional key, follow these steps before the deadline:
* **Access Form:** Log in and click the **'Objection Form'** tab.
* **Details:** Fill in your roll number and select the specific **Question ID**.
* **Evidence:** You must upload supporting documentary proof (Book name, Author, Page number) in **PDF/JPG/JPEG** format (max 400 KB).
* **Submission:** Review your entry carefully as submitted objections cannot be edited.

website_content.summary: RCF Ltd invites applications for 10 posts of Assistant Officer (Secretarial) EO Grade. Apply online between 10th September and 26th September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a Government of India Undertaking, is recruiting for the position of **Assistant Officer (Secretarial), EO Grade**.

## Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Assistant Officer (Secretarial)
* **Total Vacancies:** 10
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 30,000 - Rs. 1,20,000
* **Approximate Gross Salary:** ₹65,000 per month
* **Job Locations:** Trombay/Thal units, Area Offices & Marketing Offices across India

## Important Dates
* **Registration Starts:** 10 September 2026 (8:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 26 September 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Eligibility Cut-off Date:** 01 July 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification (Two Routes)
* **Route A:** Graduate (any discipline) + Post Graduate (any discipline) + 1-year Govt-recognized Diploma in Secretarial Practice/Stenography/Office Management.
* **Route B:** Bachelor's degree specifically in Office Management & Secretarial Practice/Office Administration + Post Graduate (any discipline).

### Experience & Requirements
* **Work Experience:** Minimum 4 years of relevant experience as Secretarial Assistant/Secretary (post-graduation).
* **Minimum Marks:** 55% in final year of Graduation (50% for SC).
* **Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026):** UR/EWS: 32 years | OBC (NCL): 35 years | SC: 37 years.

## Selection Process
1. **Online Test:** 100 Objective questions (50 Discipline-related + 50 General Aptitude/English).
2. **Skill Test (Qualifying):** Assessing Practical Job Knowledge, Computer Knowledge, and Communication Skills.

## Application Fee

website_content.title: APPSC Group A & B Gazetted (Technical) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC invites online applications for 37 Gazetted technical posts across the Finance and Home Departments. Eligible APST candidates must apply by 12 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has announced recruitment for **Group-A & Group-B Gazetted (Technical) Posts-2026 (Part-II)**. This is a prestigious opportunity for permanent residents of Arunachal Pradesh to serve in the Finance and Home Departments.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Finance & Accounts Officer / Treasury Officer:** 7 Posts (Group-A, Level 10)
* **Sub-Treasury Officer:** 7 Posts (Group-B, Level 7)
* **Assistant Director (Prosecution):** 5 Posts (Group-A, Level 10)
* **Assistant Public Prosecutor:** 18 Posts (Group-B, Level 8)

## Eligibility Criteria
**Mandatory Requirements:**
* **Nationality:** Citizen of India.
* **Residence:** Must hold a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh.
* **Status:** Must be an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) member.
* **Language:** Proficiency in an indigenous tribal language of Arunachal Pradesh is essential.

**Educational Qualification:**
* **Finance/Treasury Roles:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or any degree with Statistics/Mathematics as a compulsory subject.
* **Legal Roles:** Bachelor of Law (LLB) with a minimum of 7 years of active practice in criminal courts (or experience as a First Class Magistrate).

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** 21 September 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Application Deadline:** 12 October 2026 (5:00 PM)

## Selection Process
1. **Screening Test:** Objective type (conducted if application volume is high).
2. **Written Examination:** Consists of General English & GS (150 marks) and two Subject Papers (150 marks each).
3. **Viva-Voce:** Final interview (50 marks).

## Age Limit
* **Minimum:** 21 Years
* **Maximum:** 35 Years
* **Relaxation:** Up to 5 years for APST and up to 15 years for APST PwBD candidates.

website_content.summary: Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) has announced the semester results for UG and PG law programs. Students can now access and download their provisional marksheets online.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KSLU Result 2026 Overview
Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) has officially released the semester results for various law courses for the 2026 session. Students are advised to download their marksheets for academic record-keeping.

**Key Details:**
* **Courses Included:** LLB (3-year), BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB (5-year integrated), and LLM.
* **Result Mode:** Online via official portal.
* **Login Credentials:** Registration Number or Seat Number.

## Steps to Check KSLU Result 2026
1. Visit the official university portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Examination'** or **'Results'** section on the homepage.
3. Select your specific **course, semester, and exam session** from the dropdown menu.
4. Enter your **Registration/Seat Number** and the captcha code.
5. Click **Submit** to view your marksheet.
6. Download the PDF and take a printout for future reference.

## Important Guidelines for Students
* **Official Source:** Only use the official KSLU website to avoid fraudulent third-party links.
* **Verification:** Carefully check your name, registration number, and subject-wise marks immediately after downloading.
* **Provisional Nature:** Note that the online marksheet is **provisional**. The original marksheet will be issued by your respective college or the university.
* **Discrepancies:** Report any errors in marks or personal details to your college examination cell immediately.
* **Revaluation:** Students seeking Revaluation (RV) or Challenge Valuation (CV) should check the official notification for fees and deadlines.

website_content.markdown_content:
## BSF Answer Key 2026 Overview
The Directorate General, Border Security Force (BSF), under the Ministry of Home Affairs, has released the provisional answer keys for recruitment notifications under 2024. This applies to candidates who appeared for exams on **1 and 3 September 2026**.

### 📌 Posts Covered
* **ASI (Stenographer)** - Direct Entry & LDCE across all CAPFs
* **HC (Ministerial)** - LDCE across all CAPFs
* **Non-GD Cadre Posts** in BSF

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Dates:** 1 & 3 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release:** 10 September 2026
* **Objection Window:** 10 September to 12 September 2026
* **Special Case:** Candidates who took the HC (Ministerial) exam on 2 September (Jaipur & Kanpur centres) can access their portal **after 18 September 2026**.

### 🛠️ How to Download & Challenge
1. **Visit Official Portal:** Go to the BSF recruitment website.
2. **Login:** Use your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/DOB.
3. **Review:** View your candidate response sheet and compare it with the provisional answer key.
4. **Raise Objection:** Select the question, provide supporting documentary evidence, and pay the objection fee (if applicable).
5. **Submit:** Save the confirmation page for future reference.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* The objection window closes strictly on **12 September 2026** for most posts.
* Ensure all supporting documents are uploaded to avoid rejection of the challenge.
* Download a copy of your response sheet for your own records.

website_content.summary: The Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), UP has released the Round 1 MBBS cutoff and seat allotment results for NEET UG 2026. Candidates can now verify college-wise and category-wise opening and closing ranks.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP NEET UG Round 1 MBBS Cutoff 2026

The **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh** has officially announced the Round 1 seat allotment result and the corresponding cutoff ranks for MBBS admissions 2026.

### 📌 Quick Overview
* **Exam:** NEET UG 2026
* **Counselling Authority:** DGME, Uttar Pradesh
* **Course:** MBBS
* **Counselling Round:** Round 1
* **Result Date:** September 7, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Cutoff/Allotment
1. Visit the official UP NEET counselling portal.
2. Navigate to the **Counselling Section**.
3. Select the **"Allotted Candidate List"** or **"Allotted and Vacant Seats"** option.
4. Choose the Round 1 MBBS cutoff details.
5. Review the institute-wise and category-wise opening and closing ranks.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Category Verification:** Always check the cutoff for your specific category (**General/EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD**) as ranks vary significantly.
* **Specific Combinations:** Remember that a closing rank is specific to a combination of college, course, category, and quota.
* **Official Source:** Rely solely on the official DGME portal for allotment status; avoid unofficial estimates.
* **Admission Process:** Allotted candidates must complete reporting and admission formalities within the deadline prescribed by DGME.
* **Round 2 Outlook:** Closing ranks for Round 1 are not guaranteed for Round 2, as seats may shift.
* **Documentation:** Keep your NEET UG scorecard, rank letter, and other verification documents ready.

website_content.title: MP Police Constable Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026
website_content.summary: Complete guide to the MP Police Constable 2026 recruitment process, featuring the detailed syllabus, exam pattern, and physical standards conducted by MPESB.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The MP Police Constable recruitment is conducted by the **Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB)**. The selection process is multi-stage, ensuring only the most fit and capable candidates are selected for the force.

## Exam Pattern
The written examination is a **Computer Based Test (CBT)** designed at an 8th-class difficulty level.

* **Total Questions:** 100 MCQs
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 120 Minutes
* **Negative Marking:** No Negative Marking

### Subject-wise Distribution
* **General Knowledge & Reasoning:** 40 Marks
* **Intellectual Ability & Mental Ability:** 30 Marks
* **Science & Simple Arithmetic:** 30 Marks

## Selection Process
1. **Written Exam:** Qualifying CBT covering GK, Reasoning, and Mathematics.
2. **Physical Tests:** Includes the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST).
3. **Final Stages:** Document Verification and Medical Examination.

## Physical Standards (PST)
| Category | Gender | Height | Chest |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UR / SC / OBC | Male | 168 cm | 81 cm – 86 cm |
| UR / SC / OBC | Female | 155 cm | N/A |
| ST | Male | 160 cm | 76 cm – 81 cm |
| ST | Female | 155 cm | N/A |

## Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
Candidates must qualify in the following events:
* **800m Run**
* **Shot Put**
* **Long Jump**

## Preparation Tips
* **Focus on Basics:** Since the level is 8th class, strengthen your fundamentals in Maths and Science.
* **Balanced Study:** Allocate time proportionally across all three sections (40/30/30).
* **Physical Training:** Start training for the 800m run and jumps early; do not wait for written results.

website_content.summary: SAC ISRO is inviting online applications for 48 temporary positions including JRF, Research Associate, and Project Scientist-I. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ISRO SAC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Space Applications Centre (SAC), a lead centre of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, is recruiting for temporary, project-based positions across various scientific and engineering disciplines.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 10.09.2026 (10:00 hrs)
* **Application Deadline:** 30.09.2026 (17:00 hrs)
* **Cut-off Date for Age/Qualification:** 30.09.2026

###  vacancies Breakdown (Total: 48)
* **Junior Research Fellow (JRF):** Post Codes 01–07 (Semiconductors, VLSI, Photonics, Atmospheric Sciences, Computer Science, etc.)
* **Research Associate (RA):** Post Codes 08–10 (Oceanic Sciences, Mathematics, Physics, Environmental Sciences)
* **Project Scientist-I (PS-I):** Post Codes 11–16 (Geophysics, Ecology, Remote Sensing, Hydrology, RF & Microwave)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**Educational Qualification:**
* **JRF:** M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc in relevant fields. **Note:** Must have qualified NET, GATE, or other national-level exams.
* **RA:** Ph.D. in relevant fields OR M.E./M.Tech with 3 years of research/teaching experience and one SCI-listed journal paper.
* **PS-I:** Ph.D. or M.E./M.Tech in specialized fields (e.g., Geophysics, Water Resources).

**Minimum Marks Required:**
* **M.E./M.Tech:** 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA.
* **B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc:** 65% aggregate or 6.84 CGPA.

### ⏳ Age Limit (as of 30.09.2026)
* **JRF:** Maximum 28 Years
* **RA / PS-I:** Maximum 35 Years
* *Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST (5 years) and OBC-NCL (3 years) as per Govt rules.*

### 💰 Salary & Fellowship
* **JRF:** ₹37,000 (1st & 2nd Year) $ightarrow$ ₹42,000 (Subsequent years) + HRA
* **Project Scientist-I:** ₹56,000 + HRA
* **Research Associate:** ₹58,000 to ₹67,000 (Depending on level) + HRA

### 🛠 Selection Process
* The selection is strictly **Interview-based**. Shortlisting will be done based on academic records and subject specialization if applications are high.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Maharashtra B.Pharma & Pharm.D Admission 2026-27

The State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra, has progressed to the CAP Round 1 stage for pharmacy admissions. While the **Final Merit List is now available**, please note that the Round 1 seat matrix is temporarily on hold and will be published shortly.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Final Merit List:** Released
* **Choice Filling (Expected):** September 10 - September 11, 2026
* **Seat Matrix:** To be published soon

### 📝 Step-by-Step Guide to Choice Filling
1. **Login:** Visit the portal and log in using your Application ID and Password.
2. **Selection:** Navigate to the CAP Round 1 Option Form and select preferred colleges/course codes.
3. **Ordering:** Arrange your choices in strict order of preference.
4. **Confirmation:** Save the draft and **lock the form using SMS or Email OTP**. 
5. **Verification:** Download the 'Confirmed Option Form PDF' for your records.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Hardware:** Use a **desktop or laptop** to avoid errors during the drag-and-drop reordering of preferences.
* **Browser:** Use updated versions of Chrome, Firefox, or Edge with **pop-up blockers disabled** for OTP verification.
* **Session Timeout:** The portal has a **15-minute idle timeout**; save your drafts frequently.
* **Locking:** If you do not lock the form with an OTP, the system will auto-lock the saved choices at the deadline.
* **Seat Forfeiture:** Failure to submit required documents or the **₹1,000 seat acceptance fee** within the timeline will result in automatic forfeiture of the seat.

website_content.title: SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) PE & MT Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the PE&MT Admit Card for 7,201 Delhi Police Constable posts. Eligible candidates who cleared the CBT can now download their hall tickets for the physical test on 18 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚨 SSC Delhi Police Constable PE & MT 2026

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially released the **Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT) Admit Card** for the Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Recruitment. This is the critical second stage for candidates who have successfully cleared the Computer Based Examination (CBT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** 10 September 2026
* **PE & MT Exam Date:** 18 September 2026
* **CBT Result Date:** 19 June 2026

### 🏃 Physical Endurance Test (PET) Eligibility

**For Male Candidates:**
* **Up to 30 Years:** 1600M Race (6 Mins) | Long Jump (14 Ft) | High Jump (3.9 Ft)
* **30-40 Years:** 1600M Race (7 Mins) | Long Jump (13 Ft) | High Jump (3.6 Ft)
* **Above 40 Years:** 1600M Race (8 Mins) | Long Jump (12 Ft) | High Jump (3.3 Ft)

**For Female Candidates:**
* **Up to 30 Years:** 1600M Race (8 Mins) | Long Jump (10 Ft) | High Jump (3 Ft)
* **30-40 Years:** 1600M Race (9 Mins) | Long Jump (9 Ft) | High Jump (2.9 Ft)
* **Above 40 Years:** 1600M Race (10 Mins) | Long Jump (8 Ft) | High Jump (2.6 Ft)

### 📏 Physical Measurement Test (PMT)
* **Height (Male):** UR/OBC/EWS/SC: 170 cms | ST: 165 cms
* **Height (Female):** UR/OBC/EWS: 157 cms | SC/ST: 155 cms
* **Chest (Male):** UR/OBC/EWS/SC: 81-85 cms | ST: 76-80 cms

### 📂 Required Documents
Candidates must carry the following to the venue:
* **Printed copy** of the PE & MT Admit Card
* **Original valid photo ID proof**
* Any other specific documents mentioned in the individual admit card

### 🛠️ Selection Process
1. Computer Based Test (CBT)
2. Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE & MT)
3. Document Verification
4. Medical Examination
