website_content.title: Odisha NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration
website_content.summary: The OJEE Committee has opened Round 2 registration for MBBS and BDS admissions under the 85% state quota. New candidates must register by September 8, 2026, to participate in the allotment process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Odisha NEET UG Counselling 2026 - Round 2

The **OJEE (Odisha Joint Entrance Examination) Committee**, under the Directorate of Medical Education and Training, is now accepting registrations for Round 2 of state-quota counselling for **MBBS and BDS** admissions.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Fresh Registration (New Candidates):** September 7 to September 8, 2026 (until 11:59 PM)
* **Provisional/Final Merit List:** September 9, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 9 to September 10, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Basis
* **Basis:** Allotment is based on the **NEET UG 2026 score/rank**.
* **Quota:** Admissions are for the 85% state quota, including participating private medical colleges.

### 📝 Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Login:** Access the official portal using your NEET UG 2026 roll number and credentials.
2. **Registration:** Complete the Round 2 form (for new registrants) by Sept 8.
3. **Verification:** Upload required documents for online verification.
4. **Payment:** Pay the counselling fee via the online gateway.
5. **Choice Filling:** Between Sept 9-10, select and arrange your preferred colleges in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Ensure you lock your choices before the window closes on Sept 10.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Round 1 Candidates:** If you were not allotted a seat in Round 1, you **do not** need to register again; proceed directly to choice filling.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates upgrading in Round 2 retain their Round 1 seat unless a higher-preference seat is allotted.
* **Deadlines:** The registration window is very short (2 days)—ensure submission well before the cutoff.

website_content.title: NBEMS NEET PG 2026 Provisional Answer Key and Response Sheet
website_content.summary: NBEMS is set to release the provisional answer key and candidate response sheets for NEET PG 2026 on September 10, 2026. This initiative follows a Supreme Court order to ensure greater transparency in the examination process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET PG 2026 Answer Key Overview

The **National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)** will release the provisional answer key for the NEET PG 2026 exam. For the first time, candidates will have access to both the provisional answer key and their individual response sheets to estimate their probable scores.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Date:** August 30, 2026
* **Re-exam (Jaipur Centres):** September 5, 2026
* **Answer Key Release (Expected):** September 10, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download
1. Visit the official portal at **nbe.edu.in** or **natboard.edu.in**.
2. Navigate to the **NEET PG 2026** section.
3. Log in using your **Registration/Roll Number** and password/date of birth.
4. Click on the link for the **Provisional Answer Key and Response Sheet**.
5. Save the document as a PDF for your records.

### 🚩 Raising Objections
Candidates who find discrepancies in the provisional key can challenge the answers during a limited window. 
* Log in to the applicant portal.
* Go to the **Objection Section**.
* Upload supporting evidence and pay the required fee per question (if applicable).

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Avoid third-party links:** Use only official NBEMS websites.
* **Unofficial Keys:** Use memory-based keys for rough estimates only; rely on the official key for final scoring.
* **Confidentiality:** Full question papers are not released; only Question IDs and response sheets are provided.

### 📌 Posts Included in Final Result
* **Special Tiger Guard** (STPF)
* **Fireman**
* **Constable IRBn** (Post Code 7/26)
* **Constable Civil Police - Male** (Post Code 9/26)
* **Constable Civil Police - Female** (Post Code 8/26)
* **Constable Band, IRBn** (Post Code 5/26)
* **Constable Bugler, IRBn** (Post Code 6/26)

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Advertisement Published:** 13.03.2026
* **Provisional Result:** 20.06.2026
* **Document Verification:** 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026
* **PST, PET & Trade Test:** 13.07.2026 to 26.07.2026
* **Medical Fitness Test:** Starting 10.08.2026
* **Revised Final Result Date:** 05.09.2026

* **Result Revision:** The result was revised to address a grievance regarding One Time Age Relaxation (OTR) for a specific candidate, leading to changes in some post preferences and waitlists.

* **Verification:** All selections are provisional. The final appointment is subject to character, antecedents, and document verification by the Appointing Authority.

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official APSSB website.
2. Navigate to the **'Notice'** section.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Gujarat TAT-S Mains Hall Ticket 2026

The **State Examination Board (SEB), Gandhinagar** is set to release the hall tickets for the Teacher Aptitude Test Secondary (TAT-S) Mains examination. This is the final stage for candidates aspiring to become Secondary School Teachers for Classes 9 and 10.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Prelims Exam Date:** May 3, 2026
* **Prelims Result Declared:** July 4, 2026
* **Mains Hall Ticket Release:** September 14, 2026
* **Mains Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### 📋 Exam Overview
* **Conducting Body:** State Examination Board (SEB), Gandhinagar
* **Post Name:** Secondary School Teacher (Classes 9 and 10)
* **Stage:** Mains (Main Examination)
* **Mode of Admit Card:** Online Download

### 🛠️ How to Download the Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official website: **sebexam.org**
2. Navigate to the notice board or exam section and click on the **'TAT-S Mains Hall Ticket 2026'** link.
3. Enter your **confirmation number/seat number** and **date of birth**.
4. Submit the details to view and download the hall ticket PDF.

### ⚠️ Essential Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Documents:** Carry a printed copy of the hall ticket and a valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, or Voter ID) to the exam centre.
* **Verification:** Carefully check your name, photograph, exam centre, and reporting time on the ticket.
* **Discrepancies:** If any information is incorrect, contact the SEB helpline or email via the official website immediately.
* **Precaution:** Download your ticket early to avoid server congestion on the final day.

website_content.title: BPSSC Company Commander (Gulma Samadesta) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: BPSSC invites applications for 65 posts of Company Commander exclusively for serving Bihar Home Guards. The application window closes on October 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has announced recruitment for the post of **Gulma Samadesta (Company Commander)** in the Bihar Home Guard Vahini Seva Sanvarg. This is a promotion-based recruitment specifically for eligible serving personnel.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 65
* **Post Name:** Company Commander (Gulma Samadesta)
* **Pay Scale:** Pay Level-6
* **Application Mode:** Online Only

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 07-09-2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 10-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 10-10-2026
* **Cut-off Date (Eligibility):** 01-08-2026

## Eligibility Criteria
**This recruitment is NOT open to the general public.**
* **Service Requirement:** Must be an enrolled and trained member of the Bihar Home Guard Vahini.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of service/duty completed.
* **Service Tenure:** Minimum 10 years of remaining service as of the cut-off date.
* **Education:** Graduate degree from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** 24 to 50 years (as of 01-08-2026).

## Physical Standards
* **Height (Men):** 165 cm (Gen/BC), 160 cm (EBC/SC/ST)
* **Height (Women):** 155 cm (All Categories)
* **Chest (Men):** 81-86 cm (Gen/BC/EBC), 79-84 cm (SC/ST)
* **Weight (Women):** Minimum 48 kg

## Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Examination:** MCQ-based test on General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
2. **Main Examination:** Two papers (General Hindi and General Studies/Science/Math).
3. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Qualifying test including Race, High Jump, Long Jump, and Shot Put.

## Application Fee
* **All Categories:** ₹100 (Online payment only)

website_content.markdown_content:
## JKSSB Admit Card 2026 Overview

The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has issued an official notice regarding the release of admit cards for the **BCG Technician** and **Paramedical Assistant** recruitment under the Health and Medical Education Department (Notification No. 07 of 2025, Item Nos. 30-34 & 122-130).

* **Exam Date:** September 10, 2026 (Shift I & Shift II)
* **Exam Mode:** OMR Based Written Examination
* **Admit Card Download Start Date:** September 07, 2026
* **Department:** Health and Medical Education Department, J&K

## Step-by-Step Instructions to Download Admit Card

* Visit the official portal of JKSSB.
* Locate and click on the **Download E-Admit Card** link on the homepage.
* Sign in using your registered **Username** and **Password**.
* Download the E-Admit Card and take a clear printout for the exam day.

## Essential Guidelines for Candidates

* **Reporting Time:** Report to your designated exam centre at least **2 hours prior** to exam commencement for Biometric and Facial Authentication.
* **Issues in Downloading:** Candidates unable to download hall tickets must visit the JKSSB Board office at least 2 days prior to the exam with proof of application submission and fee payment.
* **Photo Mismatch:** Any mismatch in the photograph must be reported immediately to the JKSSB Central Office in Jammu or Srinagar prior to the exam day.
* **Post-Exam Protocol:** Duly signed admit cards must be submitted back to the invigilator after completing the examination.

website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚌 GSRTC Helper Recruitment 2026-27

Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) has announced a massive recruitment drive for the post of **Helper**. This is a contract-based fixed pay appointment for a period of five years.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 2510
* **Post Name:** Helper
* **Salary:** ₹21,100/- per month (Fixed Pay)
* **Employment Type:** Contract (5 Years)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed at least a one-year course from a Government-recognised **ITI** in any of the following trades:
    * Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Diesel, General Mechanic, Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Sheet Metal Worker, Automobile Body Repairer, Welder, Welder cum Fabricator, Machinist, Carpenter, Painter General, or Automobile Paint Repairer.
* **Additional Weightage:** Candidates with an NCVT certificate and apprenticeship in the same trade will receive additional marks.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (Age relaxations apply for Female, Reserved, PwD, and Ex-Serviceman candidates).

### 📝 Selection Process & Exam Pattern
Selection is based on a **100-mark MCQ examination** and apprenticeship certification.

**Weightage Breakdown:**
* MCQ Exam: 90 Marks
* Apprenticeship Certificate: 10 Marks

**Exam Syllabus (100 Marks | 2 Hours):**
* Trade-related subjects: 50 Marks
* GK / Gujarat History / Geography / Current Affairs: 30 Marks
* Basic Computer Knowledge: 10 Marks
* Gujarati Grammar: 5 Marks
* English Grammar: 5 Marks

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 7th September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 6th October 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 8th October 2026

### 💰 Application Fee
* **Unreserved:** ₹300 + GST
* **Reserved/Female/EWS/SC/ST:** ₹200 + GST

website_content.summary: The West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) has declared the WB JELET 2026 Round 1 seat allotment result on September 8, 2026. Candidates must complete fee payment and physical reporting by September 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## WB JELET 2026 Round 1 Seat Allotment Released

The **West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)** has officially declared the Round 1 Seat Allotment Result for **JELET 2026** on September 8, 2026. Candidates who completed registration and choice locking can now log in to check their allotted seat for Lateral Entry into 2nd year (3rd semester) B.E / B.Tech / B.Pharm degree courses.

### Important Dates for JELET 2026 Counselling

* **Round 1 Allotment Result:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Acceptance Fee (₹5,000) & Physical Reporting:** September 8 to September 10, 2026 (till 5:00 PM)
* **Round 2 (Upgradation) Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Round 2 Reporting:** September 11 to September 13, 2026
* **Mop-Up Round Registration:** September 15 to September 17, 2026
* **Mop-Up Round Allotment Result:** September 19, 2026

### Options Available After Allotment

* **No-Upgradation (Seat Freeze):** Select this if you are satisfied with the seat. Pay the ₹5,000 seat acceptance fee and complete physical admission at the allotted institute.
* **Yes-Upgradation:** Pay the seat acceptance fee and report to retain the Round 1 seat while staying eligible for a better seat in Round 2.

### How to Check Allotment Status

1. Visit the official WBJEEB portal.
2. Click on the **JELET 2026 Round 1 Seat Allotment Result** link.
3. Enter your **Application Number / Roll Number**, **Password**, and **Security PIN**.
4. View your allotment details and download the provisional allotment letter.

### Important Instructions

* Paying the online seat acceptance fee alone **does not** confirm admission. Physical reporting with original documents is compulsory.
* Failure to report within the deadline leads to automatic seat cancellation and disqualification from Round 2.

website_content.summary: The Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Tamil Nadu is conducting online counselling for MBBS, BDS, and allied medical courses based on NEET UG 2026 scores.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Tamil Nadu NEET UG Counselling 2026

The **Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Tamil Nadu** has announced the online counselling process for admissions to **MBBS, BDS, and allied medical courses** for the 2026 session. This process manages the allocation of 85% state quota seats and 100% of seats in private medical colleges within the state.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Round 1 Result Date:** August 27, 2026
* **Round 1 Reporting/Joining Window:** August 27 to September 5, 2026
* **Round 2 Schedule:** September 7, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Scope
* **Requirement:** Based on NEET UG 2026 scores and the Tamil Nadu state merit list.
* **Seats Covered:** 85% State Quota + 100% Private Medical College seats.
* **Exclusions:** 15% All India Quota (AIQ) and central/deemed university seats are handled by the MCC.

### 🛠️ Counselling Procedure
1. **Online Registration:** Register via the official DME Tamil Nadu portal.
2. **Choice Filling:** Select and lock preferred colleges and courses.
3. **Seat Allotment:** Processing based on rank, category, and choices.
4. **Result Declaration:** Check and download the provisional allotment order.
5. **Reporting:** Visit the allotted institute for document verification and confirmation.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Choice Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline; unlocked choices may be ignored.
* **Reporting:** Failure to report within the specified joining window may lead to the forfeiture of the seat.
* **Updates:** Regularly check the official website for Round 2 and Round 3 updates.

website_content.summary: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda is inviting applications for various temporary and contractual teaching and non-teaching positions. Interested candidates must apply online and attend walk-in interviews starting from September 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Central University of Punjab Recruitment 2026

Central University of Punjab (CUPB), Bathinda has announced various contractual vacancies for eligible candidates under Advertisement No. CUPB/26-27/012.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Contractual Faculty (B.Tech CSE):** 01 Post
* **Part-Time Faculty (Music, Law, Physics, Maths, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, Economics):** 08 Posts
* **Senior Analyst (Food Testing Lab):** 01 Post
* **Laboratory Assistant:** 03 Posts
* **Laboratory Attendant:** 02 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Contractual Faculty:** Bachelor's & Master's in relevant discipline with First Class in either.
* **Part-Time Faculty:** As per UGC Regulations 2018 (PG with 55% + B.Ed/NET/SLET/PhD).
* **Senior Analyst:** UG/PG in Science/Engineering (55%) with 4-5 years of research experience in Food/Water testing.
* **Laboratory Assistant:** Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences/Biotech/Bioinformatics with 2 years experience.
* **Laboratory Attendant:** 10+2 (Science) OR 10th Pass with Science and 2 years experience.

### 💰 Salary Structure
* **Contractual Faculty:** Rs. 64,000 /month
* **Senior Analyst:** Rs. 65,000 /month
* **Laboratory Assistant:** Rs. 40,800 /month
* **Laboratory Attendant:** Rs. 28,800 /month
* **Part-Time Faculty:** Rs. 1,000 /lecture (Max Rs. 50,000 /month)

### 📅 Important Interview Dates
* **Part-Time Faculty:** 09 & 10 September 2026
* **Contractual Faculty & Senior Analyst:** 11 September 2026
* **Lab Assistant & Attendant:** 14 & 15 September 2026

### 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Online Application**
2. **Document Verification**
3. **Walk-in Interview**
4. **Presentation** (for specific posts)

website_content.summary: WBMCC has announced the Round 2 registration schedule for MBBS and BDS admissions for the 2026 session. Registration opens on September 7, 2026, for State, Management, and NRI quota seats.
website_content.markdown_content:
## WB NEET UG Round 2 Counselling 2026

The West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC) has officially opened the registration window for **Round 2 of NEET UG Counselling 2026**. This phase covers admissions for MBBS and BDS courses across various quotas in West Bengal.

### 🏥 Seats Covered
* **Government Medical & Dental Colleges:** 85% State Quota seats.
* **Private Medical Colleges:** State Quota, Management Quota, and NRI Quota seats.
* **Private Dental Colleges:** State Quota and Management Quota seats.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 7, 2026 (from 1:00 PM)
* **Registration & Payment Deadline:** September 9, 2026 (Registration till 6 PM, Payment till midnight)
* **Physical Document Verification:** September 9-10, 2026 (For new/unverified candidates)
* **Seat Matrix Publication:** September 12, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 12 (6:00 PM) to September 14 (10:00 AM)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 15, 2026
* **Reporting at Institute:** September 16 to 18, 2026

### 📝 Key Instructions
* **New Registration:** Permitted only for those who did not register in Round 1 or whose candidature has changed.
* **Verification:** Candidates already verified in Round 1 are exempt from physical verification in Round 2.
* **Process:** Registration $\rightarrow$ Document Verification $\rightarrow$ Choice Filling $\rightarrow$ Allotment $\rightarrow$ Reporting.

website_content.title: Calicut University B.Arch One Time Internal Improvement Result 2026
website_content.summary: Calicut University has declared the B.Arch III, V, and IX Semester Internal Improvement results for the 2012 scheme. Students can now check their marks on the official result portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Result Overview
Calicut University has officially released the results for the **B.Arch One Time Internal Improvement Examination** held in January 2026. This announcement applies specifically to students under the **2012 Scheme (2012-16 Admission)**.

## Key Highlights
* **University:** Calicut University
* **Examination:** B.Arch One Time Internal Improvement
* **Semesters Declared:** III, V, and IX Semester
* **Admission Batch:** 2012-16
* **Result Date:** 7 September 2026

## Steps to Check Result
1. Visit the official result portal: **results.uoc.ac.in**.
2. Locate the link for the **III, V, or IX Semester B.Arch One Time Internal Improvement Examination**.
3. Click on the link corresponding to your semester.
4. Enter your **Register Number** in the required field.
5. Submit the form to view and download your result.

## Troubleshooting
* **Result Not Visible?** Double-check that you have selected the correct semester, scheme, and admission batch.
* **Server Issues:** If the page fails to load, wait a few minutes as high traffic may slow down the portal.
* **Discrepancies:** For marks confirmation, contact the **Calicut University Pareeksha Bhavan** (Examination Wing) directly.

website_content.summary: KPSC has released the final answer keys for the combined recruitment examination of Last Grade Servants, Storeman, and Lower Division Clerks. Candidates who appeared for the exam on August 1, 2026, can now verify their responses.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Kerala PSC Final Answer Key 2026

The Kerala Public Service Commission (KPSC) has officially published the **Final Answer Key** for the combined recruitment examination covering Category Codes **423/2025, 618/2025, 619/2025, and 620/2025**.

### Exam Details
* **Posts:** Last Grade Servants (LGS), Storeman, and Lower Division Clerk (LDC)
* **Question Paper Code:** 073/2026
* **Exam Date:** 1 August 2026
* **Key Release Date:** 7 September 2026

### Key Highlights
* **Mediums Available:** Separate answer keys are provided for Malayalam, Tamil, and Kannada mediums.
* **Verification:** Candidates must match the answer with the **Alpha Code (A, B, C, or D)** printed on their specific question booklet.
* **Status:** This is the **Final Answer Key** signed by the Section Officer; it is not a provisional draft.
* **Scoring:** Questions marked as deleted ('X') are typically excluded from the final score calculation.

### How to Check Your Answer Key
1. Navigate to the official KPSC website.
2. Access the **Answer Key (OMR Exams)** section.
3. Select the PDF corresponding to your medium (Malayalam/Tamil/Kannada).
4. Match your question number with the corresponding alpha code column to find the correct option.

website_content.title: Rajasthan SET Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The University of Kota (UOK) has released the admit cards for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) 2026. This exam determines eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor across various subjects in Rajasthan.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Rajasthan SET 2026 Overview
The University of Kota (UOK) has officially released the admit cards for the **Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) 2026**. Candidates who have successfully applied online can now download their hall tickets to appear for the examination.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 12 June 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14 June 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 10 August 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** 07 September 2026
* **Examination Date:** 13 September 2026

## 📝 Exam Pattern & Selection
Selection is based solely on a written objective-type test consisting of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs):

* **Paper I:** 100 Marks | 50 Questions
* **Paper II:** 200 Marks | 100 Questions
* **Total Duration:** 3 Hours (180 Minutes)
* **Note:** There is no break between Paper I and Paper II; all questions are compulsory.

## 🚀 How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official University of Kota (UOK) website.
2. Navigate to the **'Rajasthan SET 2026 Admit Card'** link on the homepage.
3. Enter your registered application credentials to log in.
4. View and download your admit card.
5. Take a clear printout for submission at the exam center.

website_content.summary: Exim Bank of India invites applications for 8 backlog vacancies for Deputy Manager and Manager roles. Apply online from 15th September to 10th October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏦 Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 Overview

Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) has announced a **Special Recruitment Drive (SRD)** to fill backlog vacancies for high-level banking positions. This is a premier opportunity for Finance professionals and Chartered Accountants to join an all-India financial institution.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I):** 6 Posts
* **Manager (Grade/Scale MM II):** 2 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 8 (Reserved for SC, ST, and OBC)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Educational Qualification (Common for both posts):**
* Minimum **50% marks in Graduation** (3-year full-time).
* **Post Graduation:** MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade (minimum 2-year full-time with 50% marks) **OR** Chartered Accountant (CA) with mandatory ICAI membership.
* *Note: Distance/Correspondence degrees are not eligible.*

**2. Experience Requirements:**
* **Manager (MM II):** Minimum 3 years of experience in internal/credit audit within a scheduled commercial bank or reputed financial institution.
* **Deputy Manager (JM I):** Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in project finance, credit appraisal, or cross-border risk analysis.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15-09-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 10-10-2026
* **Written Examination:** November 2026 (Tentative)

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Deputy Manager:** Approx. **₹18 Lakh annual CTC**
* **Manager:** Approx. **₹20 Lakh annual CTC**
* Additional perks include leased accommodation, housing loans, and vehicle loans as per Bank rules.

### ✍️ Selection Process
1. **Written Test (70% Weightage):** Subjective professional knowledge test (100 Marks).
2. **Personal Interview (30% Weightage):** Conducted in Mumbai and New Delhi.

### 📝 Application Fee
* **OBC:** ₹600
* **SC / ST / PwBD / Female:** ₹100 (Intimation charges)

website_content.title: Nandyal Anganwadi Worker & Helper Recruitment 2026 – 70 Vacancies Announced
website_content.summary: The Office of the District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal, has issued a notification for 70 Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts. Eligible local female candidates can apply offline through their respective CDPO offices by September 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Overview

The District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal District, Andhra Pradesh, has released a official recruitment notification (No. WDC02-ESTOAS(AWS)/1/2025-SA(1)-WDCWNDL) for 70 Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper positions across 6 ICDS Projects.

### Vacancy Details

* **Anganwadi Worker (AWW):** 3 Posts (Atmakur, Nandyal Projects)
* **Anganwadi Helper (AWH):** 67 Posts (Dhone, Allagadda, Atmakur, Nandyal, Banaganapalli, Nandikotkur Projects)
* **Total Posts:** 70

### Important Dates

* **Notification Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Application Start Date:** September 5, 2026 (10:30 AM)
* **Application Submission Deadline:** September 18, 2026 (5:00 PM)

### Eligibility Criteria

* **Gender & Local Residency:** Only local resident married female candidates belonging to the respective mandal/village/habitation are eligible.
* **Educational Qualification:**
  * **Anganwadi Worker:** Passed SSC / 10th Class.
  * **Anganwadi Helper:** Passed SSC / 10th Class (In case 10th-pass candidates are unavailable, candidates with lower qualifications who can read & write will be considered).
* **Age Limit (as on 01.07.2026):**
  * General Range: 21 to below 35 years.
  * Relaxation: 18 years and above in notified ICDS habitation areas if 21+ candidates are not available.

### Key Documents Required (Self-Attested Copies)

* Class 10th Marks List / Transfer Certificate (TC)
* Age Proof / Date of Birth Certificate
* Caste Certificate
* Residence Certificate
* Aadhaar Card & Ration Card
* Special Category Proof (Widow certificate / PHC Disability certificate if applicable)

### How to Apply

1. Download or collect the application form for your specific project/AWC.
2. Fill out all required fields carefully and attach self-attested copies of all requisite certificates.
3. Submit the completed application form in person at the respective **Child Development Project Officer (CDPO)** office before the deadline (September 18, 2026, 5:00 PM).

## Karnataka PG Dental 2026 Counselling Overview

The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially announced the schedule for Round 1 online seat allotment for MDS admissions for the 2026 academic session.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Option Entry Window Opens:** September 5, 2026 (4:00 PM)
* **Option Entry Window Closes:** September 7, 2026 (11:00 AM)
* **Mock Allotment Result:** September 7, 2026 (After 4:00 PM)
* **Round 1 Provisional Result:** September 9, 2026 (After 6:00 PM)

### 🛠️ How to Enter Options
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Log in using your **registered credentials** (Registration/CET number and password).
3. Carefully review the **Seat Matrix and Fee Structure**.
4. Select and arrange preferred colleges and MDS specialisations in order of priority.
5. Submit options before the deadline and monitor the mock allotment result.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Eligibility:** Qualifying NEET MDS 2026 is necessary but not a guarantee of a seat; allotment depends on rank, category, and option entry.

* **Mock Result:** The mock allotment is for indicative purposes only and cannot be used for reporting.
* **Verification:** Always rely on the official KEA portal for seat matrix and fee details.

website_content.summary: MAHA Metro has announced 56 contractual vacancies for Nagpur and Pune Metro projects for experienced professionals. Eligible residents of Maharashtra must submit offline applications by September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MAHA Metro) is inviting applications for experienced personnel to join the **Nagpur and Pune Metro Rail Projects** on a contractual basis for 3 years.

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 56 (40 for Nagpur, 16 for Pune)
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Speed Post)
* **Eligibility:** Indian Nationals, residents of Maharashtra with experience in Metro/Railways/Govt/PSUs.

## Vacancy Details
| Post | Nagpur | Pune | Total |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Junior Engineer (Various) | 08 | 01 | 09 |
| Office Assistant / Sr. Office Asst | 09 | 07 | 16 |
| Technician (Various Trades) | 14 | 04 | 18 |
| MTS cum Motor Driver | 01 | 00 | 01 |
| Attendant | 08 | 04 | 12 |

## Educational Qualifications
* **Junior Engineer:** B.E./B.Tech or 3-year Diploma in relevant engineering discipline.
* **Sr. Office Assistant:** Degree in Library Science or Mass Communication.
* **Office Assistant:** Graduation in any discipline.
* **Technician:** ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in relevant trade.
* **MTS cum Motor Driver:** SSC passed.
* **Attendant:** HSC passed.

## Age Limit (as of 25.09.2026)
* **JE & Technician:** Maximum 40 years.
* **Office Staff, MTS & Attendant:** Maximum 45 years.
* *Age relaxation applicable as per Govt norms for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD.*

## Salary Structure (IDA Pay Scale)
* **JE & Sr. Office Assistant:** Rs. 33,000 - 1,00,000
* **Office Assistant:** Rs. 25,000 - 80,000
* **Technician:** Rs. 20,000 - 60,000
* **MTS cum Motor Driver:** Rs. 16,000 - 50,000
* **Attendant:** Rs. 14,000 - 40,000

## Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** 70 Marks (General Aptitude & Domain Knowledge).
2. **Interview:** 30 Marks (Experience & Domain Knowledge).
3. **Merit List:** Based on combined marks.
4. **Medical Examination:** Pre-Medical Examination (PME) at nominated hospital.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 10 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25 September 2026 (until 6:00 PM)

* **Post Name:** Green Marshal

## MAH BBA CAP 2026 Round 4 Overview
The State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra, has announced the **Round 4 (Final) Seat Allotment** for the 2026-27 academic session. This process covers admissions for BBA, BMS, BCA, BBM, and Integrated MBA (1st year) programmes across the state.

* **Round 4 Allotment Date:** September 5, 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC Stenographer Grade 'C' & 'D' Exam 2026

**The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially released the admit cards for the Stenographer Grade "C" and Grade "D" Computer-Based Examination (CBE).** Candidates who successfully applied for these posts can now access their hall tickets via the regional SSC portals.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** September 6, 2026
* **Computer-Based Examination:** September 9 to 15, 2026
* **City Intimation Slip Released:** August 31, 2026
* **Original Application Deadline:** May 15, 2026

### 📝 Exam Overview
* **Exam Stage:** Tier-I (Computer-Based Examination)
* **Login Requirements:** Registration Number/Roll Number and Date of Birth or Password
* **Mode of Download:** Online via official SSC regional portals

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Download Process
1. Visit the official SSC website.
2. Navigate to the **"Admit Card"** section on the homepage.
3. Select your respective **SSC Regional Website**.
4. Click the link: **"SSC Stenographer Grade 'C' & 'D' Admit Card 2026."**
5. Enter your login credentials and the captcha code.
6. Download and take a clear printout of the hall ticket.

### ⚠️ Mandatory Exam Day Instructions
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the venue at least **60 minutes** before the reporting time.
* **Required Documents:** A printed copy of the admit card and one **original valid photo ID** proof.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, and calculators are strictly forbidden inside the hall.
* **Note:** The city intimation slip is NOT a substitute for the actual admit card.

website_content.summary: TSU invites online applications for 17 high-level contractual posts, including Senior Officer and Assistant Registrar, by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TSU Recruitment 2026 Overview

“Tribhuvan” Sahkari University (TSU), an Institution of National Importance, is inviting applications for **17 contractual posts** across various administrative and technical categories. These positions are for a period of three years, with some also open for deputation.

## Vacancy & Salary Breakdown

* **Executive Engineer Cum Manager Estate / Manager Placement**: ₹1,27,000 per month
* **Assistant Registrar (Various streams)**: ₹1,06,000 per month
* **Senior Officer / Consultant / Resident Engineer**: ₹88,000 per month

## Eligibility Criteria

### 1. Senior Officer & Consultant
* **Qualification**: Bachelor's Degree with MBA/PG Diploma in Management or equivalent.
* **Experience**: Minimum 5 years of supervisory experience in Pay Level 6+.

### 2. Assistant Registrar
* **Qualification**: MBA (Finance), CA, ICWA, or M.Com.
* **Experience**: Minimum 5 years of supervisory experience in Pay Level 7+ (Audit/Accounts/Admin).

### 3. Executive/Resident Engineer
* **Qualification**: B.E. in Civil/Electrical/Architectural Engineering.
* **Experience**: 8 to 10 years of post-qualification experience with supervisory roles.

### 4. Manager Placement
* **Qualification**: Master's Degree in Management, Marketing, or Public Relations.
* **Experience**: Minimum 10 years in corporate relations or talent acquisition.

## Important Information

* **Age Limit**: 40 to 50 years (depending on the post). Age relaxation applies for SC/ST/OBC/PwD as per Govt of India rules.
* **Selection Process**: Screening Test $\rightarrow$ Physical Interview $\rightarrow$ Final Selection based on overall performance.
* **Application Mode**: Online only via the official careers portal.

## Key Dates

* **Application Deadline**: 30th September 2026 (23:59 hrs)

website_content.title: SSC JHT Admit Card 2026 - Combined Hindi Translators Examination
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Admit Card for the Combined Hindi Translators Examination (CHT) 2026 Paper-I. Candidates appearing for the exam on 8th September 2026 can now download their hall tickets from the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JHT Admit Card 2026 Overview

The **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the **Combined Hindi Translators Examination (CHT) 2026**. Candidates who applied for the various translator posts can now access their admit cards for the Paper-I exam.

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 6th September 2026
* **Paper-I Exam Date:** 8th September 2026
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)

### 📋 Posts Covered
This recruitment covers multiple translator roles, including:
* Junior Hindi Translator (JHT)
* Junior Translation Officer (JTO)
* Junior Translator (JT)
* Senior Hindi Translator (SHT)
* Senior Translation Officer (STO)

### 🚀 How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official SSC website: **ssc.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **"Admit Card"** section on the homepage.
3. Click on the link: **"Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 – Download Admit Card for Paper-I"**.
4. Enter your **Registration Number/Roll Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
5. Verify the details on your admit card and take a clear printout.

### ⚠️ Important Exam-Day Instructions
* **Reporting Time:** Arrive at the exam center at least **30 to 45 minutes** before the scheduled reporting time.
* **Prohibited Items:** Electronic devices, calculators, and study materials are strictly not allowed.
* **Verification:** Double-check your name, photograph, and shift details. Contact the regional SSC office immediately if any errors are found.

website_content.title: Karnataka UG NEET Counselling 2026 Round 2 Option Entry
website_content.summary: KEA has opened the Round 2 option entry for MBBS and BDS admissions under the state quota for NEET UG 2026. Eligible candidates must submit or modify their college preferences by September 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the Round 2 option entry for **MBBS and BDS admissions**. This process is for candidates eligible for the 85% state quota as well as private and deemed college seats based on their NEET UG 2026 scores.

## Important Dates
* **Round 2 Option Entry Begins:** September 7, 2026 (Expected)
* **Round 2 Option Entry Closes:** September 9, 2026
* **Round 1 Seat Allotment Result:** August 19, 2026

## Step-by-Step Process for Option Entry
1. **Portal Access:** Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. **Login:** Use your registered registration number and password.
3. **Seat Matrix Review:** Carefully analyze the Round 2 seat matrix for medical and dental colleges.
4. **Preference Entry:** Add, delete, or re-order your college and course preferences according to your priority.
5. **Confirmation:** Save changes frequently and submit the final list. Download the confirmation page for your records.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Seat Matrix:** Always verify the current seat matrix, as availability changes between rounds.
* **Technical Precaution:** Avoid last-minute submissions to prevent portal crashes or load issues.
* **Verification:** Cross-verify all eligibility and category rules directly from the official KEA notification.

website_content.summary: The High Court of Jharkhand is inviting applications for 25 contractual Law Researcher/Research Associate positions. Eligible law graduates and final-year students can apply via email by September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi has announced the engagement of **Law Researchers and Research Associates** on a contractual basis. This is a prestigious opportunity for fresh law graduates and academic achievers to work within the judiciary.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Posts:** 25
* **Remuneration:** Rs. 40,000 per month
* **Engagement Period:** 1 Year (Extendable up to 2 Years)
* **Application Mode:** Email (Single PDF file under 10MB)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * Fresh Law Graduates or Post Graduates from a BCI recognized University.
    * Final year students of 3-year or 5-year LL.B courses are eligible (must pass before engagement).
* **Academic Performance:** Must have passed all examinations in the **first attempt** with at least **60% aggregate marks**.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 28 years (as of advertisement date).
* **Preferential Skill:** Familiarity with computers.

## Selection Process
The selection will be conducted based on **Merit** and a subsequent **Interview**.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 05 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 28 September 2026

## Required Documents
* Matriculation Certificate (DOB proof)
* Law Degree/Marksheets
* Recommendation from a Senior Advocate or Head of Law School/College
* Computer Certificate (if available)

website_content.title: WBJEE Decentralised e-Counselling 2026 Registration
website_content.summary: WBJEEB has announced the Decentralised e-Counselling 2026 to fill remaining vacant seats in Engineering, Pharmacy, and Architecture institutes. Registration and choice filling are expected to begin on September 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **WBJEE Decentralised e-Counselling 2026** is conducted to fill vacant seats in participating institutes after the conclusion of regular counselling rounds. This is a crucial opportunity for eligible candidates to secure admission into Engineering, Pharmacy, and Architecture courses.

## Important Dates
* **Registration & Choice Filling (Phase 1):** September 7, 2026 (Expected)
* **Phase 1, Round 1 Seat Allotment:** September 10, 2026

## Application Process
1. **Login:** Access the portal using your application/roll number and password.
2. **Update Details:** Verify personal, academic, and category information.
3. **Payment:** Pay the required counselling registration fee online.
4. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred courses and institutes in order of priority.
5. **Confirmation:** Save and print the final confirmation page.

## Key Instructions
* **Choice Volume:** It is highly recommended to enter a large number of choices; submitting no choices results in no allotment.
* **Timelines:** Ensure registration is completed within the window as late submissions are not accepted.

website_content.summary: KEA has released the Round 2 provisional cutoff ranks and seat allotment for DCET 2026 lateral entry admissions. Candidates must complete fee payment by September 9 and report to colleges by September 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has announced the **Round 2 Provisional Cutoff and Seat Allotment** for the Diploma Common Entrance Test (DCET) 2026. This process facilitates lateral entry admission into the second year of Engineering and the first year of Architecture courses in Karnataka.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Round 2 Option Entry Started:** September 2, 2026
* **Round 2 Provisional Cutoff/Allotment Release:** September 5, 2026
* **Fee Payment Window:** September 7 to September 9, 2026
* **Last Date to Report at Allotted College:** September 10, 2026

## 🛠️ Counselling Process
* **Verification:** Registration and document verification.
* **Option Entry:** Candidates select preferred colleges and courses online.
* **Allotment:** KEA prepares allotments based on rank, category, and preference.
* **Confirmation:** Allotted candidates pay the acceptance fee and download the admission order.
* **Reporting:** Physical reporting at the college with original documents.

## 🔍 How to Check Allotment Result
1. Visit the official KEA website.
2. Locate the **'DCET 2026 Round 2 Cutoff'** or **'Round 2 Seat Allotment'** link.
3. Log in using your **CET application number** and password/DOB.
4. Download and save the cutoff PDF or your individual allotment order.

## ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* Use only official domains: `cetonline.karnataka.gov.in` or `keaonline.karnataka.gov.in`.
* Missing the reporting deadline (Sept 10) will lead to **automatic cancellation** of the seat.
* Keep all original documents ready for verification to avoid last-minute delays.

website_content.title: Delhi High Court Personal Assistant (PA) Recruitment 2026: Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: The High Court of Delhi has released the official syllabus and exam pattern for the recruitment of 150 Personal Assistants (PA). Candidates must navigate a rigorous four-stage selection process to secure a position.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Delhi is recruiting for the post of **Personal Assistant (PA)** and **Senior Personal Assistant (SPA)**. To succeed, candidates must clear four distinct stages of examination. 

## Selection Process
The selection process is sequential; candidates must clear each stage individually:
* **Stage I: English Typing Test** (Qualifying only)
* **Stage II: English Shorthand Test** (Counts toward final merit)
* **Stage III: Main Descriptive Examination** (Written)
* **Stage IV: Interview** (Final Stage)

## Detailed Exam Pattern

### 1. English Typing Test (Stage I)
* **Duration:** 10 Minutes
* **Requirement:** Min. 40 words per minute (wpm)
* **Permissible Errors:** 3% of total words

### 2. English Shorthand Test (Stage II)
* **Speed:** 100 wpm
* **Format:** 500 words dictated in 5 minutes
* **Transcription Time:** 45 minutes
* **Marks:** 110 Marks
* **Disqualification:** More than 25 mistakes leads to failure

### 3. Main Descriptive Exam (Stage III)
* **Total Marks:** 100 | **Duration:** 120 Minutes
* **Essay (250 words):** 40 Marks
* **Letter Writing:** 15 Marks
* **Grammar & Comprehension:** 25 Marks
* **Translation (Hindi to English):** 10 Marks
* **Translation (English to Hindi):** 10 Marks
* **Qualifying Marks:** 45% for Reserved/PwBD candidates

### 4. Interview (Stage IV)
* **Total Marks:** 15 Marks
* **Minimum Qualifying Marks:** None

## Preparation Strategy
* **Focus on Speed:** Daily practice for 100 wpm shorthand and 40 wpm typing is critical as these are the first hurdles.
* **Master Descriptive English:** The Essay carries the highest weightage (40 marks); practice structured 250-word essays on administrative topics.
* **Bilingual Proficiency:** Regular practice of Hindi-English translation to secure the 20 marks available in Stage III.

website_content.summary: CGDME has commenced Round 2 registration for MBBS and BDS seats in government and private medical colleges. Qualified NEET UG 2026 candidates must apply by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Directorate of Medical Education, Chhattisgarh (CGDME) has officially opened the registration window for **Round 2 of the NEET UG 2026 state counselling**. This is a critical opportunity for candidates seeking admission into MBBS and BDS courses across state quota and private medical/dental colleges in Chhattisgarh.

* **Notice Released:** September 4, 2026
* **Registration Start Date:** September 5, 2026
* **Choice Filling Start Date:** September 5, 2026
* **Registration Deadline:** September 8, 2026

## Eligibility & Courses
* **Requirement:** Must be a qualified candidate of **NEET UG 2026**.
* **Courses Available:** MBBS and BDS.
* **Seat Types:** Government and Private college seats (State Quota).

## Application Process
1. **Registration:** Visit the official portal to login (existing users) or register (new users).
2. **Update Details:** Review and update personal and academic information.
3. **Documentation:** Upload necessary scanned certificates.
4. **Payment:** Pay the applicable registration fee online.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses.
6. **Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline to be considered for allotment.

website_content.title: MP NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration
website_content.summary: Registration and edit window for MBBS and BDS seats under the 85% state quota for MP NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 is now open. Conducted by the Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Madhya Pradesh.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Madhya Pradesh, has announced the commencement of **Round 2 registration** for candidates seeking admission to MBBS and BDS courses under the **85% state quota** based on the Re-NEET UG 2026 results.

## Key Highlights
* **Courses:** MBBS and BDS
* **Quota:** 85% State Quota
* **Registration Mode:** Online via official portal
* **Eligibility:** Based on NEET UG 2026 results (declared July 16, 2026)

## Important Dates
* **Registration/Edit Window:** September 5 to September 6, 2026 (until 11:30 PM)
* **Revised Merit List (Expected):** September 7, 2026
* **Physical Reporting (Tentative):** September 12 to September 18, 2026

## Seat Allotment Process
1. **Merit List:** DME publishes the revised merit list for Round 2.
2. **Choice Filling:** Eligible candidates must complete fresh choice filling of colleges/courses.
3. **Locking:** Choices must be locked before the deadline (non-editable after locking).
4. **Allotment:** Based on rank, category, choices, and reservation policy.
5. **Reporting:** Allotted candidates must report to the college for document verification.

## How to Apply
* Visit the official DME MP portal.
* Select the **Round 2 Registration** or **Registration Edit** link.
* Enter NEET UG 2026 roll number and personal details.
* Pay the registration fee and security deposit online.
* Upload required documents: Scorecard, 10th/12th marksheets, Domicile, and Category certificates.
* Complete e-verification and choice filling after the merit list is released.

## Critical Instructions
* **Fresh Choice Filling:** Compulsory for all candidates in Round 2, including those seeking upgradation. Round 1 choices will NOT carry forward.
* **Duplicate Registration:** Round 1 registered candidates should NOT create a new registration; use the edit option instead.

website_content.title: ESIC Medical College Pune Recruitment 2026: Teaching Faculty & Senior Residents
website_content.summary: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Pune is inviting walk-in interviews for 46 contractual posts including Professors and Senior Residents from September 7 to 11, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune has issued Advertisement No. 10 of 2026 for the recruitment of **teaching faculty and Senior Residents** on a contractual basis. This drive aims to fill existing and newly arising vacancies.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Professor:** 08 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 11 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 09 Posts
* **Senior Resident (3 Year):** 15 Posts
* **Senior Resident (1 Year):** 03 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 46

## Eligibility & Age Limit
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must fulfill requirements as prescribed by the **National Medical Commission (NMC)** guidelines.
* **Age Limit (Faculty):** Maximum 68 Years.
* **Age Limit (Senior Resident):** Maximum 45 Years.
* *Age relaxation applies as per Govt of India rules.*

## Remuneration (Approximate)
* **Professor (Level 13):** Rs. 2,57,000
* **Associate Professor (Level 12):** Rs. 1,70,000
* **Assistant Professor/Senior Resident (Level 11):** Rs. 1,50,000

## Important Dates & Venue
* **Walk-in Interview Dates:** 07 September 2026 to 11 September 2026
* **Reporting Time:** 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM
* **Interview Timing:** 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM
* **Venue:** ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune, Maharashtra

## Application Fee
* **General/Other:** Rs. 500/- (via Demand Draft in favor of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1", payable at Pune)
* **SC/ST/PwD/Female/ESIC Contractual Employees:** Nil

## Selection Process
Selection will be based on a **Personal Interview** conducted by the Selection Board, followed by document verification.

website_content.summary: The District Programme Officer, Amroha, is inviting online applications from eligible women for 105 Anganwadi Karyakartri posts. The application window is open from September 4 to September 24, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026

The Office of the District Programme Officer (Bal Vikas evam Pushtahar), Amroha, has announced the recruitment of **105 Anganwadi Karyakartris** across seven Child Development Project areas in the Amroha district. These positions are on an honorarium basis.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 03.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 04.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 24.09.2026 (Midnight)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 01.07.2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only women candidates are eligible.
* **Residence:** Must be a resident of the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward. If unavailable, residents of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat may be considered.
* **Education:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent. Preference will be given to candidates with higher qualifications (up to Postgraduate).
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of 01.07.2026).

### 📍 Vacancy Distribution
| Project Name | Type | Posts |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Amroha Shahar | Urban | 10 |
| Amroha Dehat | Rural | 9 |
| Dhanaura | Rural | 26 |
| Gajraula | Rural | 17 |
| Gangeshwari | Rural | 6 |
| Hasanpur | Rural | 12 |
| Joya | Rural | 25 |
| **Total** | | **105** |

### 🏆 Selection Process & Priority
Selection is based on a merit list derived from educational qualifications. Special priority is given in the following order:
1. **BPL** widow/legally divorced/separated women.
2. Above-poverty-line widow/divorced/separated women.
3. Other eligible candidates based on educational merit.

### 📝 Key Instructions
* **Application Mode:** Online only.
* **Documents:** Digitally verifiable residence and caste certificates are mandatory.
* **Income Limit:** Rural: ₹46,080 | Urban: ₹56,460 (Annual).

## DSSSB Warder (Male) PET 2026

The **Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB)** has officially released the admit cards for the Physical Endurance Test (PET) for the post of **Warder (Male), Post Code 15/25**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** 5 September 2026

* **Long Jump:** 12 feet

* **EWS:** 121.56
* **OBC:** 70.04
* **SC:** 110.46
* **ST:** 98.63

* **Category certificates** (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) if applicable
* Ex-Servicemen/Sportsperson certificates if claiming quota

website_content.title: Mizoram PSC (MPSC) Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: MPSC has announced the admit card download schedule and written examination dates for Inspector of Excise & Narcotics, State Tax Officer, Junior Engineer (Civil), and Motor Vehicle Inspector posts.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MPSC Admit Card 2026-27

The Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) has released the official schedule for downloading admit cards and the dates for written examinations for four key positions. Candidates must access their hall tickets through their individual accounts on the MPSC Online Portal.

### 📅 Examination & Download Schedule

| Post & Department | Admit Card Download Window | Exam Date |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Inspector of Excise & Narcotics / State Tax Officer** | 4th - 15th Sept, 2026 | 23.09.2026 to 25.09.2026 |
| **Junior Engineer (Civil) - P&E** | 21st Sept - 1st Oct, 2026 | 06.10.2026 & 07.10.2026 |
| **Motor Vehicle Inspector (MVI)** | 5th - 15th Oct, 2026 | 27.10.2026 & 28.10.2026 |

### 🛠️ How to Download Your Admit Card
* Visit the official MPSC Online Portal.
* Log in using your candidate account credentials.
* Navigate to the admit card section for your specific post.
* Download and print the admit card within the specified timeframe.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Check for Rejections:** If your application was not accepted, a rejection message with the reason will be available in your portal account.
* **Document Verification:** Possessing an admit card does not guarantee final eligibility; candidates can be rejected at any stage if uploaded documents are found unsatisfactory.
* **Exam Details:** Reporting time and center address are mentioned specifically on the downloaded admit card.

website_content.title: Delhi High Court Senior Personal Assistant & Personal Assistant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The High Court of Delhi is inviting online applications for 150 vacancies of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) and Personal Assistant (PA). The application window is open from September 15 to October 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The High Court of Delhi has announced vacancies for **Senior Personal Assistant (SPA)** and **Personal Assistant (PA)** positions. This is a Group 'B' recruitment aimed at filling existing vacancies and creating a panel for future requirements.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 150
* **Senior Personal Assistant (SPA):** 117 Posts (Pay Level 8)
* **Personal Assistant (PA):** 33 Posts (Pay Level 7)

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Graduate** from a recognized university.
* **Technical Skills (SPA):** Shorthand (English) $\ge$ 110 w.p.m. and Typewriting (English) $\ge$ 40 w.p.m.
* **Technical Skills (PA):** Shorthand (English) $\ge$ 100 w.p.m. and Typewriting (English) $\ge$ 40 w.p.m.

### Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026)
* **Minimum:** 18 Years
* **Maximum:** 32 Years
* **Relaxations:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

## Selection Process
Candidates will be evaluated through a four-stage process:
1. **English Typing Test:** Qualifying stage (40 w.p.m.).
2. **English Shorthand Test:** Merit-based transcription test.
3. **Main Descriptive Examination:** Essay, Letter Writing, Grammar, and Translation.
4. **Interview:** Final personality and suitability assessment.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15.09.2026 (11:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 05.10.2026 (11:00 PM)
* **Correction Window:** 12.10.2026 to 14.10.2026

## Application Fee
* **General / OBC-NCL / EWS:** ₹1,500
* **SC / ST / PwBD:** ₹1,300

website_content.title: TNEA B.Arch Counselling 2026 Rank List and Seat Allotment
website_content.summary: The Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu, is releasing the TNEA B.Arch 2026 rank list today. Candidates can proceed with online registration, choice filling, and seat allotment via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNEA B.Arch Counselling 2026 Overview
The Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu, is conducting the admission process for first-year **Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch)** programmes. The entire process, from registration to seat allotment, is handled digitally.

### 📅 Key Dates (Tentative)
* **Rank List Publication:** 05 September 2026 (Expected Today)
* **Tentative Allotment Release:** 01 August 2026
* **Provisional Allotment:** 02 August 2026
* **Reporting/Joining Dates:** 02 to 06 August 2026
* **Upward Opted Provisional Allotment:** 08 August 2026

### 📝 Admission Process
1. **Registration:** Create login credentials with basic personal and academic details.
2. **Application:** Submit NATA/JEE scores, category details, and upload original certificates.
3. **Verification:** Complete document verification (online or at designated centres).
4. **Rank Check:** Log in to view your rank and category position after publication.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and branches. **Tip:** Enter as many valid choices as possible to ensure allotment.
6. **Allotment:** Confirm tentative allotment within the same-day window and download the provisional order.
7. **Reporting:** Visit the allotted college with original documents to finalize admission.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* All dates are tentative; verify the live notification on the portal.
* **Confirmation Window:** Tentative allotments usually require confirmation within a narrow window (typically 10 AM to 7 PM).
* **B.Arch Specific:** Do not confuse these dates with B.E./B.Tech supplementary counselling, as B.Arch is a separate process.
* Keep your NATA/JEE scorecards and academic certificates ready for every stage.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The U.P. Co-operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB), Lucknow, has officially released the hall tickets for candidates appearing in the **Combined Co-operative Banking and Technical Services Examination (Special Recruitment) 2026** (Advt. No. A-1/S.R./2026).

## Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** 4 September 2026
* **Exam Dates:** 7 and 8 September 2026
* **Exam Stage:** Direct Mains Exam (No Prelims)

## Post-Wise Exam Schedule
| Date | Shift | Post Name |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 7 Sept | 08:35 AM - 10:35 AM | Manager |
| 7 Sept | 12:35 PM - 02:35 PM | Assistant / Cashier |
| 7 Sept | 04:05 PM - 06:05 PM | Junior Manager |
| 8 Sept | 08:35 AM - 10:35 AM | Assistant Engineer (Civil) |
| 8 Sept | 12:35 PM - 02:35 PM | Assistant / Typist |

## Mandatory Documents for Exam Day
* **Admit Card:** Printed copy with photograph affixed.
* **Photo ID Proof:** Original and one photocopy (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, etc.).
* **Photograph:** One passport-size photo.
* **Note:** Aadhaar Card is mandatory for biometric/IRIS authentication.

## Important Instructions
* **Dress Code:** Light clothing, half sleeves, and slippers/sandals. Avoid large buttons, badges, or shoes.
* **Prohibited Items:** Calculators, electronic devices, and notes are strictly forbidden.
* **Reporting:** Report to the center well before the gate closing time mentioned on the hall ticket.

website_content.summary: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) invites applications for admission to Class XI for the 2027-28 session through the Lateral Entry Selection Test. The registration window is open from 2nd September to 30th September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NVS Class XI Lateral Entry Selection Test 2027

**Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)**, under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, has announced the admission process for **Class XI (11th)** for the academic session 2027-28 against vacant seats in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** 2 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 September 2026 (Wednesday)
* **Date of Selection Test:** 10 April 2027 (Saturday)

### 🎓 Admission Details
* **Admission Class:** Class XI (11th)
* **Academic Session:** 2027-28
* **Selection Method:** Lateral Entry Selection Test
* **Application Fee:** No fee required at any stage

### 📝 Application Process
1. Visit the official NVS portal.
2. Read the notification-cum-prospectus for eligibility.
3. Fill in basic details: state/district of residence and study, and Aadhaar number.
4. Upload required documents: Photograph and signatures (Candidate & Parent).
5. Select up to **two streams** and up to **three preferred JNVs** per stream.
6. Review and submit the final application.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Aadhaar Mandatory:** Candidates without an Aadhaar number must apply for enrolment before registering.
* **Verification:** Provisional selection is subject to successful document verification.
* **Transfer Certificate:** Apply for TC from the current school only after admission confirmation by the allotted JNV.
* **Accuracy:** No correction requests will be entertained after the correction window closes.

website_content.summary: KEA has released the Round 3 provisional seat allotment for KCET 2026. Candidates must exercise their choice by September 6, 2026, to secure their allotted seats.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially announced the Round 3 Provisional Seat Allotment results for the Karnataka UGCET (KCET) 2026 counselling process. Candidates are now required to log in and exercise their choice (including Choice 4) to confirm their admission status.

## Important Dates
* **Round 3 Result Date:** September 4, 2026
* **Choice Entry Window Opens:** September 4, 2026
* **Choice Entry Deadline:** September 6, 2026 (until 10:00 AM)

## Courses Covered
This allotment applies to the following professional courses:
* Engineering & Architecture
* Agriculture & Veterinary Science
* Pharmacy & B.Sc Nursing
* Yoga & Naturopathy
* BPT, BPO, and Allied Health Sciences

## Steps to Check Allotment & Exercise Choice
1. Visit the official KEA portal.
2. Log in using your **CET application number** and password/DOB.
3. Verify your allotted college, course, and category.
4. Select the applicable choice (Choice 1, Choice 4, etc.) displayed on your dashboard.
5. Complete the fee payment if accepting the seat and download the admission order.

## Key Instructions
* **Deadline Warning:** Failure to exercise a choice by the deadline may result in the automatic cancellation of your allotted seat.
* **Terminal Round:** Round 3 is generally considered a terminal round; ensure your selection is final.
* **Documentation:** Keep your CET number and category certificates ready for a smooth process.

website_content.title: KEA Principal Recruitment 2026: 247 Vacancies in Govt PU Colleges
website_content.summary: KEA invites applications from eligible serving lecturers to fill 247 Principal posts across Karnataka. The application window is open from September 7 to October 4, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KEA Principal Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) is recruiting for the post of **Principal in Government Pre-University Colleges** on behalf of the Department of School Education. 

**Important Note:** This recruitment is **NOT open to the general public**. It is a departmental recruitment specifically for serving lecturers.

## Vacancy Break-up
Total Vacancies: **247**
* **Residual Parent Cadre (RPC):** 216 Posts
* **Kalyana-Karnataka (KK) Local Cadre:** 31 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible, candidates must meet the following requirements:
* **Current Status:** Must be a serving Lecturer in Government Pre-University Colleges (School Education Dept).
* **Experience:** Minimum of **10 years of service** in the Lecturer cadre.
* **Probation:** Must have satisfactorily completed the probation period.

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a competitive examination consisting of three papers:
* **Paper 1:** Kannada Language Test (Qualifying only - 50 marks minimum required).
* **Paper 2:** General Studies (150 Marks).
* **Paper 3:** KCS Rules, Education Act 1983, and Educational Psychology (150 Marks).

**Marking Scheme:** 0.25 negative marking for each wrong answer in Papers 2 and 3.

## Application Fee
* **GM / 2A / 2B / 3A / 3B:** Rs. 1,500
* **SC / ST / Cat-1 / ESM / TG:** Rs. 1,000
* **PwD:** Rs. 500

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 07-09-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 04-10-2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 05-10-2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## ICSI New Exam Centres Update (December 2026 Session)

The **Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)** has expanded its examination network by introducing **7 new exam centres** on an ad hoc basis. This move aims to provide greater convenience to candidates appearing for the CS Executive and Professional programmes.

* **Uttarakhand:** Haridwar (Code: 269)
* **Maharashtra:** Ratnagiri (Code: 492)
* **Madhya Pradesh:** Rewa (Code: 493)

* **Late Fee Enrollment Deadline:** 10 October 2026 (Late fee: ₹250 per group)
* **Pre-Examination Test Deadline:** 24 September 2026 (Without late fee)

### 🛠️ How to Select New Centres
1. Log in to the **ICSI Student Portal** using your credentials.
2. Access the enrollment form for the **December 2026 session**.
3. Navigate to the **Exam Centre Preference** section.
4. Select the desired new centre from the updated drop-down list.

* These centres are opened on an **ad hoc basis** and are subject to review in future sessions.
* Candidates who have already enrolled can check the student portal for **centre-change facility** availability.
* This update does not impact the exam syllabus, pattern, or eligibility criteria.

* **Total Posts:** 72

* **Super-Speciality Disciplines:** Candidates with **DM/M.Ch** in the respective specialty are eligible.
* **Trauma & Emergency:** MD (Emergency Medicine/General Medicine/Anaesthesiology/Respiratory Medicine) or MS (General Surgery/Orthopaedics).
* **Nationality:** Indian Nationals only.
* **Registration:** Mandatory registration with NMC/MCI/State Medical Council.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** Level 11, Cell No. 01 (7th CPC)

* **Additional:** Usual allowances including Non-Practising Allowance (NPA), where applicable.

### 📅 Important Dates

* **Application Start Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 17 September 2026 (by 5:00 PM)

### 🛠️ Selection Process
* **Primary Method:** Interview at AIIMS Nagpur.
* **Note:** If application volume is high, a written test may be conducted for shortlisting.

### 📝 Application Fee
* **General/EWS/OBC:** Rs. 500
* **SC/ST:** Rs. 250
* **PwD:** Exempted

website_content.title: Delhi University (DU) Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES) Admission 2026
website_content.summary: Delhi University invites applications for the Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES) 2026 starting September 2nd. This unique program allows learners of any age to enroll in individual papers without committing to a full degree.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES)**, conducted by the Institute of Life-Long Learning (ILLL) at the University of Delhi, is designed for lifelong learners who wish to enhance their skills through specific academic papers.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** No age bar; open to all.
* **Target Audience:** Students, working professionals, and senior citizens.
* **Restriction:** Candidates currently enrolled in any regular programme at the University of Delhi are **not eligible** to apply.

## Scheme Highlights
* **Course Load:** Applicants can enroll in a maximum of **2 papers or 8 credits** per semester from the same discipline.
* **Certification:** Successful completion (based on eligibility and attendance) earns credits recorded in the **Academic Bank of Credit (ABC)** and a certificate.
* **Fee Structure:** The cost is **₹6,000 per paper**, payable via the DU Miscellaneous Fee payment system.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Deadline:** Please refer to the official portal for closing dates.

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Registration:** Create an account on the official CES portal.
2. **Course Selection:** Enter the programme name, semester, course/paper name, code, and credits.
3. **Documentation:** Upload the required documents and NOC (if applicable).

The **Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala** has officially published the Final Category List for candidates seeking admission to **MBBS and BDS** courses under the **NRI (Non-Resident Indian) Quota**.

### Overview
This list is the result of the CEE's review of sponsorship documents and the processing of objections raised against the provisional list. It is a critical step for candidates to ensure their communal/category reservation is active for the medical counselling process.

### Important Dates
* **Provisional NRI Category List:** September 2, 2026
* **Objection/Complaint Window:** September 3, 2026
* **Final NRI Category List Release:** September 4, 2026

### Steps to Check the List
1. Visit the official portal of CEE Kerala.
2. Navigate to the **KEAM/Medical Admission 2026** candidate portal.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password**.
4. Go to the **"Category List"** or **"NRI Category Status"** section.
5. Verify your status and download the confirmation/invitation letter.

### Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Verification:** Carefully cross-check your name and NEET roll number.
* **Documentation:** Keep physical and scanned copies of all NRI verification documents until the admission process is complete.
* **Official Source:** Only rely on the official CEE website for updates; avoid unofficial social media forwards.
* **Next Steps:** Monitor the portal for the subsequent counselling and choice-filling schedule.

website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the provisional answer key for the AIAPGET 2026 exam. Candidates can now download their responses and challenge any answers until September 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIAPGET 2026 Provisional Answer Key Update

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially published the **provisional answer key** for the All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination on August 22, 2026 (or the re-examination on September 1) can now verify their performance.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Answer Key Release Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Last Date to Raise Objections:** September 5, 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 🛠️ How to Download Answer Key
1. Visit the official AIAPGET portal.
2. Click on the **'Answer Key / Challenge(s)'** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Review your recorded responses and download the PDF for future reference.

### 🚩 How to Raise Objections
* Access the objection link via the official login portal.
* Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
* Upload necessary **supporting documents** as evidence.
* Pay the prescribed **objection processing fee** to make the challenge valid.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* Objections are accepted **only online**; no offline requests will be entertained.
* A challenge is only valid upon successful payment of the processing fee.
* Ensure all login credentials are ready before accessing the portal.

The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore, has officially declared the results for the **Assistant Director / Veterinary Assistant Surgeon / Veterinary Extension Officer Exam 2026**. A roll-number-wise list of provisionally shortlisted candidates for the interview round has been released.

### Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 80
* **Total Shortlisted for Interview:** 255 candidates (Part A: 193, Part B: 62)
* **Exam Date:** 2 August 2026
* **Result Date:** 3 September 2026

### Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** 3 September 2026
* **Document Submission Deadline:** 24 September 2026
* **Late Submission Window (with ₹3,000 fee):** 25 September to 1 October 2026

### Document Submission Process
Shortlisted candidates must follow these steps to ensure their candidature:
1. **Order:** Arrange all documents as per Appendix Form-01.
2. **Attestation:** Self-attest or notarize photocopies as required.
3. **Identification:** Clearly mention your name, roll number, and total page count on the form.
4. **Submission:** Send the physical set to the Secretary, MPPSC, Residency Area, Indore.
5. **Labeling:** The envelope must be clearly marked as *"Sahayak Sanchalak/Pashu Chikitsa Sahayak Shalya, Pashu Chikitsa Vistar Adhikari Pariksha-2026 ke Sakshatkar hetu Abhilekh"*.

### Important Instructions
* The current list is **provisional**; eligibility will be verified during the interview.
* Interview dates will be announced separately.
* Any candidate providing false information may be debarred at any stage of the selection process.

website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSC NDA & NA (II) 2026 Exam Overview

The **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** has officially released the e-Admit Cards for the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026. Eligible candidates who applied for the **394 vacancies** can now access their hall tickets via the official portal.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 3 September 2026
* **Exam Date:** 13 September 2026 (Sunday)
* **Application Deadline:** 11 June 2026

### 🕒 Exam Schedule & Timing
The examination will be conducted in two sessions on the same day:
* **Paper I (Mathematics):** 10:00 AM - 12:30 PM
* **Paper II (General Ability Test):** 02:00 PM - 04:30 PM

### 📄 Documents Required for Exam Day
Candidates must carry the following to the center:
* **Printed e-Admit Card** (Clear copy)
* **Original Photo ID Proof** (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, Driving Licence, or PAN Card)
* **Passport-size photograph** (if specified)

### ⚠️ Key Guidelines
* Report to the center at least **30 minutes** before the reporting time.
* Electronic devices (Mobiles, Smartwatches, Calculators) are **strictly prohibited**.
* Ensure the OMR sheet is not folded or damaged.

website_content.summary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF) invites applications for 326 Apprentice posts across Graduate, Technician, and Trade categories. Apply online by September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## RCF Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF), a **Navratna Public Sector Undertaking**, is engaging apprentices for its Trombay (Mumbai) and Thal (Raigad) units under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Graduate Apprentices:** 145 Posts (Accounts Executive, Secretarial Assistant, HR Recruitment Executive)
* **Technician Apprentices:** 105 Posts (Diploma in Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Mechanical Engineering)
* **Trade Apprentices:** 76 Posts (Attendant Operator, Instrument Mechanic, Lab Assistant, Boiler Attendant, Electrician, Horticulture Assistant, MLT)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** Must be a regular full-time course from a recognized University/Institute. (Distance/Part-time not eligible).
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (as of 01.09.2026). 
* **Age Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10 years).

### 💰 Monthly Stipend
* **Graduate & B.Sc Trades:** ₹17,300
* **Diploma Technician:** ₹15,900
* **Other Trade Apprentices:** ₹14,600
* **Extra Benefits:** Free breakfast, tea, and vegetarian lunch thali provided at company canteen.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Starts:** 4 September 2026, 8:00 AM
* **Application Deadline:** 20 September 2026, 5:00 PM

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a **Merit List** derived from the percentage marks of the essential educational qualification, followed by **Document Verification**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## MTET 2026 Result Overview
The **Directorate of Educational Research & Training (DERT), Meghalaya**, has announced the results for the Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET) 2026. The exam was conducted on **24th July 2026**, and the result was declared on **3rd September 2026** via Memo No. DERT/MTET/18/2026/22.

### 📊 Result Statistics
* **Paper I (Classes I-V) Pass Percentage:** 84.30%
* **Paper II (Classes VI-VIII) Pass Percentage:** 85.32%

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Examination Date:** 24th July 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** 3rd September 2026

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result
The results have been released as **centre-wise roll number lists** in PDF format. Follow these steps:
1. Open the official result PDF for either Paper I or Paper II.
2. Locate your **Exam Centre** name within the document.
3. Scan the list of roll numbers under your centre.
4. If your **Roll Number** is present in the list, you have been declared **passed**.

**Note:** No individual scorecard or login portal has been provided; the PDF list serves as the official result document.
